v: Ix awtaj winhaj Moisés yuj Jehová t'a yol mantiado, ix schekan yal juntzanh cheknab'il winh t'a heb' yetisraelal.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: Tato ay junok ex tzeyik'kot junok nok' nok' yik snhuschajtz'a smasanil silab'il t'a Jehová, ha t'a skal nok' he wakax, t'a skal nok' he kalnel ma t'a skal nok' he chiwa, hata' tzeyik'kot nok'.

Tato wakax nok' tze nhustz'a silab'il chi', yowalil a junok nok' toro malaj spalta'il tzeyik'koti. Ha jun silab' stz'a'i, a jun chi' to stz'ab'at nok' nok' chi' smasanil. Ha t'a yichanh mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová, hata' tzeyak'och silab' chi' yik wach' schaji yuj Jehová.
Yowalil tzeyak'k'e he k'ab' t'a sjolom nok', yik schaji nok' yuj yak'ji lajwok he mul.

Ha mach ay yik nok' chi', a smilancham nok' t'a yichanh Jehová, haxo heb' sacerdote yuninal winhaj Aarón tz'ik'ankot schik'il nok', stzikanoch heb' t'a schanhil pak'anh jun altar ayek' t'a yichanh mantiado.
Hanheja' winh ay yik nok' chi' spatz'anel nok', schok' xikanb'at nok' winh.
Haxo heb' sacerdote yuninal winhaj Aarón chi', syak'k'e te' k'atzitz heb' t'a yib'anh te' tzak'ak' t'a altar chi' yik sk'e sk'ak'al.
Tz'ak'jik'e nok' chib'ej kotak xikab'il chi' t'a yib'anh te' k'atzitz chi' yet' nok' sjolom yet' nok' xepu' tz'ik'ji'el t'a nok' yol sk'o'ol.

Ha mach tz'ak'an nok' silab' chi', yowalil a smaxan nok' yol sk'o'ol, sb'ikanel nok' yok, haxo winh sacerdote snhusantz'a jun silab' chi' smasanil t'a yib'anh altar. Suk'uk'i sjab' jun silab' stz'a chi' syab' Jehová.
Tato kalnel, ma chiwa nok' tzeyak' silab'il chi', yowalil ch'a'ak nok', malajokab' jab'ok spalta'il nok'.

Ha t'a stojolal norte t'a jun altar chi', hata' smiljicham nok' yuj mach tz'ak'an nok' chi' t'a yichanh Jehová. Haxo heb' yuninal winhaj Aarón chi' stzikanoch schik'il nok' t'a schanhil pak'anh jun altar chi'.
Slajwi chi' slaj kotak xikajb'at nok', haxo winh sacerdote tz'ak'ank'e nok' kotak xikab'ilxo yaj chi' t'a yib'anh k'ak' t'a yib'anh altar yet' nok' sjolom yet' nok' xepu' tz'el t'a nok' yol sk'o'ol.

Haxo jun mach tz'ak'an nok' silab' chi', yowalil a smaxan nok' yol sk'o'ol, sb'ikanpaxel nok' yok, haxo winh sacerdote snhusantz'a smasanil t'a yib'anh altar. Suk'uk'i sjab' jun silab' stz'a chi' syab' Jehová.
Tato much nok' silab' snhusjitz'a smasanil t'a yichanh Jehová, yowalil a junok nok' paramuch yalnhej tas makanhil.
Ha winh sacerdote tz'ik'ankot nok' silab' chi' t'a altar, stok'anel sjolom nok' winh, snhusjitz'a nok'. Haxo schik'il nok', stzikoch winh t'a spak'ul altar.
Tz'ik'ji'elta masanil yo'och nok' yet' tas ay t'a yo'ol, syumjikanb'at t'a stz'eyb'at altar t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, haton b'aj smolchaj k'e'en tik'ak'il ta'anh.

Slajwi chi' syamji sk'axil nok' yik sjekchitanb'at jab'ok nok' winh, palta max chab'axlaj snanhal nok', snhusantz'a nok' winh sacerdote t'a yib'anh te' k'atzitz ayk'e t'a yib'anh altar chi'. Suk'uk'i sjab' jun silab' stz'a chi' syab' Jehová.
Tato ay junok ex tzeyik'kot ixim harina ofrenda'il t'a Jehová, a wal ixim harina te wach' tzeyik'koti. Ha t'a yib'anh ixim chi' tzeyak'em aceite yet' incienso,

tzeyik'ankot t'a heb' sacerdote yinhtilal winhaj Aarón. Ha junok heb' sacerdote ayoch t'a yopisio tz'ik'ank'e junok b'echanh ixim harina yet' aceite yet' pax masanil incienso. Slajwi chi' snhusjitz'a jun silab' chi' t'a yib'anh altar, yuj sch'oxchaji to ha' silab' chi' yik Jehová yaji. Suk'uk'i sjab' jun ofrenda chi' syab' Jehová.
Haxo jab'okxo jun ofrenda chi' yikxo heb' winh sacerdote yaji. Niwan yelk'ochi, yujto yetb'eyum sb'a yet' jun silab' snhusjitz'a t'a yichanh Jehová.

Ha tz'ak'ji junok ofrenda k'anb'inak t'a yol horno, a'okab' ixim harina te wach', malaj yich sb'at t'a skal. Syal pim tz'aj sb'oji, skalaj yet' aceite, syalpax yoch t'a k'oxoxal to malaj yich, sukchajek' aceite t'ay.
Tato a jun ofrenda chi' mayb'il t'a yol xalten, a'okab' ixim harina yelxo wal te wach', kalab'il yet' aceite, palta mokab'a yich ayb'ati.
Skotak xepchitaji, slajwi chi' tz'och aceite t'ay, yujto ofrenda t'a tas swaji.
Tato tzeyak' junok ofrenda tajinak t'a skal aceite, a'okab' yet' ixim harina te wach', kalab'il yet' aceite tzeyak'a'.
Ayik toxo ix b'o'el jun ofrenda chi', tzeyik'ankot t'a Jehová, tzeyak'an t'a winh sacerdote, haxo winh tz'ik'anb'at t'a altar.
Hata' snhustz'a jab'ok jun ofrenda chi' winh yik ch'oxnab'il to a ofrenda chi' yik Jehová yaji. Suk'uk'i sjab' jun silab' chi' syab' Jehová.
Haxo jab'okxo jun ofrenda chi', yik heb' sacerdote tz'ajkani. Niwan yelk'ochi, yujto yetb'eyum sb'a yet' juntzanh ofrenda snhusjitz'a t'a yichanh Jehová.
Masanil juntzanh ofrenda tzeyak' t'a Jehová t'a tastak swaji, malajokab' yich ayb'at t'a skal. Max yal-laj snhusjitz'a tas silab'il t'a yichanh Jehová tato ayb'at yich pan, ma nok' yalchab' t'a skal.

Syal eyak'an ixim pan ayb'at yich t'a skal yet' tas ayb'at nok' yalchab' t'a skal t'a ofrenda'il a tz'ak'ji b'ab'el sat awb'en, palta max nhusjitz'alaj t'a yib'anh altar silab'il b'aj stz'a silab' suk'uk'i sjab' syab' Jehová.

Masanil ofrenda tzeyak' t'a tas swaji, yowalil sb'at yatz'amil, malaj junok ofrenda chi' to max b'at yatz'amil, yujto a atz'am atz'am chi' sch'oxanel ko trato yet' ko Diosal. Yuj chi' masanil ofrenda tzeyak' t'a tas swaji chi', aynhejokab'och yatz'amil.
Tato tzeyak' junok ofrenda t'a Jehová t'a sb'ab'el sat eyawb'en, yowalil a jaye'ok jolom trigo sk'anb'i t'a skal k'ak', yaxto wal swuchchajeli.
Ha t'a yib'anh jun ofrenda chi', tzeyak'och aceite yet' incienso, yujto a ofrenda chi' a ixim trigo, ma ixim cebada.
Ha junok winh sacerdote snhusantz'a jab'ok ixim wuchb'ilel chi' yet' aceite yet' pax masanil incienso. Ha jab'ok chi' sch'oxani to a ofrenda chi' yik Jehová yaji.

Tato ay junok ex tzeyak' junok snun he wakax, ma junok nok' toro silab'ok yik tze ch'oxani to ay he junk'olal yet' Jehová, yowalil tzeyik'kot nok' t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha jun nok' nok' chi' yowalil malaj jab'ok spalta'il nok'.

Ayik tzeyak'an junok ofrenda chi', tzeyik'b'at nok' t'a yichanh mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová. Hata' tzeyak'k'e he k'ab' t'a sjolom nok', slajwi chi' tze milancham nok'. Haxo junok heb' winh sacerdote stzikanoch schik'il nok' t'a schanhil pak'anh altar.

Tato ay junok ex tzeyak' junok nok' silab' yik junk'olal, tzeyik'el junok makan t'a nok' silab' chi', yik snhusjitz'a t'a yichanh Jehová, haton juntzanh tik tzeyik'eli: Masanil xepu' ayoch t'a nok' yol sk'o'ol,
chab' stut nok' yet' xepu'al, xepu' ayoch t'a spatiktak sb'akil yich spatik nok' yet' xepu' ayoch t'a yib'anh seyub' nok'.
Haxo junok heb' winh sacerdote snhusantz'a masanil juntzanh chi' silab'il t'a yib'anh junxo silab' wan stz'a t'a yib'anh te' k'atzitz t'a yib'anh altar, suk'uk'i sjab' syab' Jehová.
Tato tzeyak' junok nok' kalnel ma junok nok' chiwa t'a Jehová silab'il yik tze ch'oxan he junk'olal yet'ok, syal eyak'an nok' ch'a'ak ma nok' snun, anhej tato malaj jab'ok spalta'il nok'.
Ayik tzeyak'an nok' kalnel chi' silab'il t'a yichanh Jehová,
tzeyak'k'e he k'ab' t'a sjolom nok'. Slajwi chi' tze milancham nok' t'a yichanh mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová. Haxo junok heb' winh sacerdote stzikanoch schik'il nok' t'a schanhil pak'anh altar.

Ha junok mach ex tzeyak' junok nok' silab' chi', tzeyik'el junok makan t'a nok' yik snhusjitz'a t'a yichanh Jehová, haton juntzanh tik tz'ik'ji'eli: Xepu'al snhe nok', wach' tz'aj yik'ji'el smasanil yet' xepu' ayoch t'a nok' yol sk'o'ol,
stut nok' yet' pax xepu' ayoch t'ay, xepu' ayoch t'a yich spatik nok' yet' xepu' ayoch t'a yib'anh seyub' nok', junnhej tz'aj yik'ji'el yet' nok' stut chi'.
Slajwi chi', haxo winh sacerdote snhusantz'a juntzanh chi' smasanil silab'ok t'a yichanh Jehová to icha junok wa'el yaji.
Tato chiwa nok' tzeyak' he silab'ok chi', tzeyik'kot nok' t'a yichanh Jehová.
Haxo mach ex tzeyak' nok' chi', tzeyak'k'e he k'ab' t'a sjolom nok', tze milancham nok' t'a yichanh mantiado. Haxo heb' winh sacerdote stzikanoch schik'il nok' t'a schanhil pak'anh altar.

Ha ex mach ex tzeyak' junok nok' silab' chi', tzeyik'el junok makan t'a nok', yik snhusjitz'a t'a yichanh Jehová, haton juntzanh tik: Masanil xepu' ayoch t'a nok' yol sk'o'ol, t'a spatiktak sb'akil yich spatik nok' yet' xepu' ayoch t'a spatik seyub' nok' yet' stut nok' schab'il yet' xepu'al.
Haxo winh sacerdote snhusantz'a juntzanh chi' smasanil t'a yib'anh altar, icha junok wa'el snhusjitz'a'ok, suk'uk'i sjab' syab' Jehová. Masanil xepu'al nok' yik Jehová yaji.
Manh he chi xepu' yet' pax schik'il nok'. Ha jun tik ley tz'ajkan t'ayex t'a junelnhej yet' t'a eyinhtilal, yalnhej b'ajtil ayex ek'i, xa chi, xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' to syal juntzanh cheknab'il tik winh t'a heb' yetisraelal. Yuj chi' ix yal winh icha tik:
Tato ay mach tz'och smul, manh sk'anok sk'o'ol, sk'ulan tastak ay yowalil, hato ha' syal scheknab'il Jehová, yowalil sk'anab'ajej masanil juntzanh tastak ol wal tik:

Tato a winh sat sacerdote tz'och smul ayik ayoch winh t'a yopisio, a smul winh chi' tz'empax t'a yib'anh heb' chonhab', yowalil syak' junok nok' kelem wakax winh silab'ok t'a Jehová yuj smul chi'. Ha nok' wakax syak' winh chi', a nok' malaj jab'ok spalta'il.
Syik'ankot nok' winh t'a yichanh mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová. Syak'ank'e sk'ab' winh t'a sjolom nok', smilancham nok' winh t'a yichanh Jehová.
Ha winh tz'ik'ankot jab'ok schik'il nok' syik'anoch winh t'a yol mantiado chi'.
Syak'em yiximal sk'ab' winh t'a skal schik'il nok' chi'. Ukel stzikem winh t'a yichanh Jehová t'a yichanhelta k'apak cortina ayoch b'aj ay lugar Anhej Jehová Ay Yiko'.

Sukanoch jab'ok schik'il nok' chi' winh t'a sch'ak altar yik incienso ayoch t'a yichanh Jehová t'a yol mantiado. Haxo masanil chik' tzato kan chi', sekkanem winh t'a yichtak yok altar b'aj snhusjitz'a silab', haton jun ayem t'a yichanh mantiado chi'.
Slajwi chi' tz'ik'ji'el masanil xepu' t'a nok' yol sk'o'ol,
yet' chab' stut nok' yet' xepu'al yet' pax masanil xepu'al sb'akil yich spatik nok' yet' xepu' ayoch t'a yib'anh seyub' nok',
icha wal tz'aj yik'ji'el t'a nok' wakax tz'ak'ji silab'ok yik sch'oxan junk'olal yet' Dios. Slajwi chi', snhusjitz'a t'a yib'anh altar.
Haxo nok' stz'umal, nok' sb'ak'chil, nok' sjolom, nok' xub', nok' yok, masanil nok' yol sk'o'ol yet' masanil sch'anhtza' nok',

syalelk'ochi masanil nok' silab' chi', tz'ik'ji'el t'a junok lugar to wach' yaj t'a spatikel campamento, haton b'aj sekchajtaxonel k'e'en tik'ak'il ta'anh. Hata' snhusjitz'a nok' t'a yib'anh te' k'atzitz.
Tato ko masanil a onh chonhab' israel onh tik tz'och ko mul, manh sk'anok ko k'o'ol, malaj pax junok onh snachajel ku'uj to manh ichok yalan scheknab'il Jehová ix ko k'ulej, yuj chi' tz'och ko mul,

ayik skilankot ko b'a to ix och ko mul, yowalil skak' junok nok' kelem wakax silab'il ko masanil yik tz'ak'ji tup ko mul chi' t'a kib'anh. Skik'anb'at nok' t'a yichanh mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová.
Hata' syak'k'e sk'ab' heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' t'a sjolom nok' t'a yichanh Jehová, smiljicham nok' ta'.
Haxo winh sat sacerdote tz'ik'ankot jab'ok schik'il nok' chi' t'a yol junok yet'tal syik'anoch winh t'a yol mantiado,
slab'anem yiximal sk'ab' winh t'a skal schik'il nok' chi' stzikanem ukelok winh t'a yichanh Jehová t'a yichanhelta k'apak cortina.

Sukanek' jab'ok schik'il nok' chi' winh t'a sch'ak altar b'aj stz'a incienso, haton ayek' t'a yichanh Jehová t'a yol mantiado chi'. Haxo jantakto schik'il nok' tzato kani, stob'jikanek' t'a yich yok altar b'aj snhusjitz'a silab', haton jun ayek' t'a yichanh mantiado chi'.
Slajwi chi' tz'ik'ji'el masanil xepu'al nok' silab' chi', snhusjitz'a t'a yib'anh altar.

Syalelk'ochi, to icha wal tz'aj nok' kelem wakax syak' winh sat sacerdote yuj smul icha chi' tz'ajpax nok' tz'ak'ji chi' yuj smul heb' anima smasanil. Icha chi' syutej winh sat sacerdote chi' sb'o'an silab' yuj slajwikanel ko mul t'a kib'anh a onh tik.

Slajwi chi' tz'ik'ji'el nok' silab' chi' t'a spatikel campamento. Hata' snhusjitz'a nok', icha wal tz'utaj nok' b'ab'el kelem wakax chi', yujto a jun silab' chi' tz'ak'ji yuj yak'ji lajwok ko mul ko masanil.
Tato ay junok winh yajal tz'och smul, manh sk'anok sk'ol winh yik sk'ulan tastak to manh ichokta' yalan scheknab'il Jehová,
ayik snachajel yuj winh to ix och smul winh, yowalil syik'kot junok nok' mam chiwa winh silab'il yuj smul ix och chi'. Ha nok' syik'kot winh chi' a nok' malaj jab'ok spalta'il.
Syak'k'e sk'ab' winh t'a sjolom nok', smilancham nok' winh t'a yichanh Jehová, haton b'aj smiljitaxon nok' nok' snhusjitz'a silab'il, yujto silab' yuj smul winh yaj nok'.
Haxo junok winh sacerdote tz'ik'ankot schik'il nok' silab' chi', sukanoch winh t'a sch'ak altar b'aj snhusjitz'a silab', haxo jantakto chik' skani, stob'ankanek' winh t'a yich yok altar chi'.

Snhusjitz'a smasanil xepu'al nok' t'a yib'anh altar, icha wal tz'aj silab' tz'ak'ji yuj sch'oxji junk'olal yet' Dios. Icha chi' syutej winh sacerdote sb'o'an jun silab' chi' yik tz'ak'ji tup smul jun winh yajal t'a chonhab' chi'.
Tato ay junok komon anima tz'och smul, manh sk'anok sk'o'ol yik sk'ulan tastak to manh ichokta' yalan scheknab'il Jehová,
ayik snachajel yuj to ix och smul, yowalil syik'kot junok nok' nun chiwa silab'il yuj smul ix och chi'. Ha nok' syik'kot chi', a nok' malaj jab'ok spalta'il.
Syak'k'e sk'ab' t'a sjolom nok', slajwi chi' smilancham nok' b'aj smiljitaxoncham nok' nok' snhusjitz'a silab'il.
Haxo junok winh sacerdote tz'ik'ankot schik'il nok', sukanoch winh t'a sch'ak altar b'aj snhusjitz'a silab', haxo jantakto schik'il nok' skani, stob'ankanek' winh t'a yich yok altar chi'.

Slajwi chi' tz'ik'ji'el masanil xepu'al nok' silab' chi', icha wal tz'aj yik'ji'el yik nok' silab' tz'ak'ji yuj sch'oxan sjunk'olal yet' Dios. Snhusjitz'a xepu'al nok' chi' silab'il t'a yichanh Jehová to suk'uk'i sjab'. Icha chi' syutej winh sacerdote sb'o'an jun silab' chi' yik tz'ak'ji tup smul jun anima chi'.
Tato a nok' kalnel syik'kot jun mach tz'ak'an jun silab' chi', a junok nok' snun malaj jab'ok spalta'il syik'koti.
Yowalil syak'k'e sk'ab' t'a sjolom nok' kalnel chi', smilancham nok' b'aj smiljitaxoncham nok' nok' snhusjitz'a'ok.
Haxo junok winh sacerdote tz'ik'ankot schik'il nok', sukanoch winh t'a sch'ak altar b'aj snhusjitz'a silab', haxo jantakto schik'il nok' skani, stob'kanek' winh t'a yich yok altar chi'.

Slajwi chi' tz'ik'ji'el masanil xepu'al nok' silab' chi', icha wal tz'aj yik'ji'el yik nok' silab' tz'ak'ji yuj sch'oxan sjunk'olal yet' Dios. Snhusjitz'a xepu'al nok' chi' t'a yib'anh altar, t'a yib'anh juntzanhxo silab' to stz'ataxon t'a yichanh Jehová. Icha chi' syutej jun winh sacerdote sb'o'an jun silab' chi' yik tz'ak'ji tup smul jun anima chi'.

K'inalok ay junok mach tz'awtaj yuj yalani ma yak'an testigo'al sb'a t'a junok tas ix yila', ma ix yab'i, palta tato max yalelta yuj tas ix yil chi', ma tas ix yab' chi', a jun chi' tz'och smulok skannhej t'a yib'anh.

Hanhejtona' tato ay junok mach syaman junok tas manh wach'ok icha yalan ley, tz'och smul. K'inalok sukek' sb'a t'a sniwanil junok chamnak nok', wach'chom kaltakte'al nok', ma molb'etzal nok', ma junok nok' tzek' nhernhonok, a junok mach icha chi' sk'ulej, manh wach'ok tz'aji. Tz'och smul, wach'chom max yab'i tato ix sukek' sb'a t'a nok' chamnak nok' chi'.
K'inalok ay mach syaman junok tas tz'el t'a anima, manh wach'ok tz'ajkan yuj icha yalan ley, max nachajel yuj t'a jun rato chi', palta ayik snachajel yuj, tz'och jun chi' smulok.

K'inalok ay junok mach syak' sti' t'a yalxonhej tas lolonelal t'a elanhchamel, tato max cham wal sna'ani syak'an sti' chi', max yak'elk'och tas ix yal chi', palta ayik snachajel yuj, toxo ix och juntzanh chi' smulok.
Ha mach tz'och junok smul t'a juntzanh tastak tik, yowalil scha smulok,
syak'an junok nok' nun kalnel silab'ok yuj smul ix och chi', ma junok nok' nun chiwa. Ha jun silab' chi', snhustz'a winh sacerdote yik slajwikanel smul jun anima chi'.

Tato malaj stumin jun anima chi' b'aj sman junok nok' kalnel, ma junok nok' chiwa chi', yowalil syik'kot chawanhok nok' paramuch, yalnhej tas makanhil t'a yichanh Jehová yuj smul ix och chi'. Jun nok' tz'och yuj smul chi', junokxo nok' snhusjitz'a smasanil silab'il.
B'ab'el snhusjitz'a nok' tz'ak'ji yuj smul chi' yuj winh sacerdote, tonhej sch'umji'el sjaj nok', palta max el-laj t'a junelnhej.
Slajwi chi', sukji'och jab'ok schik'il nok' t'a spatiktak altar, haxo jantakto schik'il nok' skani, tz'ak'jikanoch t'a yich yok altar chi', yujto silab' yuj mul yaji.
Haxo junxo nok' schab'il chi', snhusjitz'a nok' icha sleyal. Icha chi' tz'aj sb'o'an silab' winh sacerdote yuj slajwikan smul jun anima chi'.
Tato malaj stumin jun anima chi' b'aj sman chawanhok nok' paramuch chi', yowalil syik'kot chanhe'ok libra ixim harina te wach', max b'atlaj aceite yet' incienso t'a skal, yujto ofrenda yuj mul yaji.

Yowalil syik'kot t'a winh sacerdote, haxo winh tz'ik'ankot junok b'echanh ixim harina chi' yik stz'a t'a yib'anh altar yuj sch'oxaneli to masanil jun ofrenda chi' yik Jehová yaji. Snhusjitz'a t'a altar t'a yib'anh juntzanhxo ofrenda wan stz'a t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha jun ofrenda chi' yuj mul tz'ak'ji.

Icha chi' tz'aj sb'o'an jun silab' chi' junok winh sacerdote yuj slajwikanel smul jun anima chi'. Ha jantakto skani, yikxo winh sacerdote chi', icha sk'ulej yet' juntzanh wa'el tz'ak'ji t'a ofrenda'il, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix schek Jehová yal winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:

K'inalok ay junok mach max ik'ankot tastak yiktaxon Jehová yaji, wach'chom manh sk'anok sk'o'ol tz'och smul. Ha jun anima chi' yowalil syik'kot junok nok' ch'ak kalnel malaj jab'ok spalta'il, syak'an nok' silab'il t'a Jehová yuj smul chi'. Yowalil snaji jantak stojol nok' ch'ak kalnel chi' t'a k'e'en plata, icha k'e'en sk'anchaj t'a skajnub' Dios.

Ha jun anima chi' yowalil stup tastak yiktaxon Jehová yaj maj yik'kot chi', syak'an jab'okxo stojol t'a yib'anh juntzanh toxo ix yak' chi' t'a winh sacerdote yet' nok' kalnel tz'ak'ji t'a silab'il yuj smul chi'. Icha chi' tz'aj sb'o'an silab' jun winh sacerdote yuj slajwikanel smul jun anima chi'.
K'inalok ay junok mach tz'och smul t'a cheknab'il ix yak' Jehová wach'chom manh sk'anok sk'o'ol, a jun chi' ayxo och smulok.

Yuj chi' syik'kot junok silab' t'a junok heb' winh sacerdote yik stupan smul chi'. Syik'kot junok nok' ch'ak kalnel malaj jab'ok spalta'il. Ha winh sacerdote chi' sna'ani to k'okb'il syab' stojol nok' chi' t'a icha wal stojol tas stupchaj chi', hanheja' winh sb'o'an jun silab' chi'. Icha chi' tz'aj slajwikanel smul ix och chi'.
Haton silab' yuj stupchaj smul chi', yujto a jun anima chi' ay smul t'a yichanh Jehová, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix schek Jehová yal winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
K'inalok ay junok mach tz'och smul t'a yichanh Jehová, yik syixtan yetanima'il t'a junok tas skan ab'enal t'ay, ma syelk'ej junok tasi, mato tonhej sk'ub'ejeli,

mato sik' junok tasi stek'b'an sb'a yalani to malaj tas syila', ma stek'b'an sb'a yalan junok tas manh yelok, ma sk'ulej junokxo chukal sk'ulej heb' anima icha juntzanh tik, yowalil syak' junok silab'.

Haxo yik snachaji to ay smul t'a junok juntzanh tik, yowalil syak'xi masanil stojol t'a mach ay yiko', syak'an jab'okxo stojol t'a yib'anh juntzanh toxo ix yak' chi' t'a mach ay yiko'. Syak'anpax junok silab' t'a Jehová yuj smul tz'och chi'.
Ha silab' syak' chi', haton junok nok' ch'ak kalnel malaj jab'ok spalta'il, ma a tumin icha stojol junok nok' ch'ak kalnel chi' tz'ak'ji t'a winh sacerdote.
Haxo winh tz'ak'anoch jun silab' chi' t'a yichanh Jehová yuj smul jun anima ix och chi', haxo jun mul chi' slajwikanel t'a yib'anh, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix schek Jehová yal winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:

Al t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yuninal yuj tas tz'aj yak'ji jun silab' to snhusjitz'a smasanil t'a junjun yemk'uhalil. Ha nok' nok' snhusjitz'a smasanil t'a silab'il chi', yowalil ayk'e nok' t'a yib'anh k'ak' tzek' ak'wal yik stz'ab'at nok'.

Haxo t'a junxo k'inhib'alil, a junok winh sacerdote yowalil syak'och junok spichul winh te wach' yet' yol swex to lino. Slajwi chi', smolank'e stanhil nok' nok' ix nhusjitz'a t'a yib'anh altar chi' winh, syak'anem winh t'a stz'eyb'at altar chi'.
Slajwi chi', sk'exanel spichul winh chi', sb'at yak'ankan stanhil nok' silab' chi' winh t'a jun lugar sik'b'ilel t'a spatikel campamento.

Ha jun k'ak' ayoch t'a yib'anh altar chi', aynhejokab'och masanil tiempo, malajokab' b'ak'inh stupi. Yowalil tz'ak'ji'och te' k'atzitz yuj heb' sacerdote t'a junjun k'inhib'alil, haton t'a yib'anh k'ak' chi' tz'ak'jik'e nok' silab' stz'a t'a junjun k'inhib'alil. Hata' stz'apax xepu'al nok' silab' yik junk'olal.
Ha juntzanhxo cheknab'il tz'alji tik, haton tas tz'aj yak'ji tas swaji t'a ofrenda'il: Ha winh sacerdote tz'ak'an t'a Jehová t'a yichanh altar,

syik'ankot junok b'echanh ixim harina yet' aceite, junnhej tz'ajb'at yet' masanil incienso yik ofrenda chi', stz'a b'aj stz'ataxon ofrenda, yuj sch'oxani to a masanil jun ofrenda chi' yik Jehová yaji, te suk'uk'i sjab' syab'i.

Haxo jantakto ofrenda chi' skani, sb'olchaji, malaj yich pan sb'at t'a skal. Swa heb' winh sacerdote t'a junok lugar to yik Jehová yaji, haton t'a yamak'il mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová. Ha juntzanh ofrenda chi', yiknhej Jehová yaji, icha yaj silab' yuj yak'ji lajwok mul, icha pax yaj silab' yuj stupchaj mul. Ix yak'kan juntzanh ofrenda tik Jehová t'a heb' sacerdote t'a skal juntzanh ofrenda tz'ak'ji t'ay to snhusjitz'a t'a yib'anh altar.

Ha sleyal jun ofrenda chi' ol kannhej t'a masanil tiempo. Ha ofrenda to yik Jehová yaji, snhusjitz'a'ok, syalnhej swa'an masanil heb' winak t'a yinhtilal winhaj Aarón. Yalnhej tastak tz'och tennaj t'a juntzanh ofrenda chi' yik Jehová tz'ajkani, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix chekji yal winhaj Moisés chi' yuj Jehová icha tik:

Haton jun ofrenda tik yowalil syak' winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal t'a Jehová, t'a sk'uhal sik'chajoch heb' t'a sacerdote'al: Chanhe' libra ixim harina te wach', yujto ofrenda tz'ak'ji t'a tas swaji. Nanhal tz'ak'ji t'a k'inhib'alil, haxo nanhalxo, ha t'a yemk'uhalil tz'ak'ji t'a jun k'u chi'.
Ha t'a yol junok xalten sb'oji jun ofrenda chi', wach' tz'aj sk'anb'i t'a skal aceite, slajwi chi' spojchaji, tz'ak'ji t'a ofrenda'il to suk'uk'i sjab' syab' Jehová.
Icha chi' ol yutejnhej junjun yinhtilal winhaj Aarón ol laj ochnhej sk'exulok t'a sacerdote'al. Yiknhej Jehová yaj jun ofrenda chi', yuj chi' snhusjitz'a smasanil t'a yichanh.
Masanil ofrenda syak' heb' sacerdote t'a tas swaji, yowalil snhusjitz'a smasanil. Malaj junok mach syal swa'ani, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi', ix yalani:

Al masanil juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al tik t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yuninal, yuj tas tz'aj snhusjitz'a silab' yuj yak'ji tup mul: Ha junok nok' silab' tz'ak'ji yuj mul chi', yowalil smiljicham nok' t'a yichanh Jehová, t'a jun lugar b'ajtaxon smiljicham nok' snhusjitz'a'ok. Ha jun silab' chi' yik Jehová yaji.
Ha winh sacerdote tz'ak'an jun silab' yuj yak'ji tup mul chi', syal schi'an winh t'a jun lugar yik Jehová yaji, haton t'a yamak'il mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová.
Yalnhej tastak tz'och tennaj t'a nok' chib'ej chi' yik Jehová tz'ajkani. Tato tz'och tzitnaj schik'il nok' t'a junok pichul, yowalil sjuk'ji'el t'a junok lugar to yik Jehová yaji.
Hanheja' lum chen b'aj stz'anhji nok' silab' chi', yowalil smak'jipoj lu'um, palta ta ha t'a yol junok chen bronce stz'anhji, anhej to snhikji'el smikal, wach' tz'aj sb'ikchaji.
Ha jun silab' chi' yik Jehová yaji. Yalnhej mach junok winak t'a yinhtilal heb' sacerdote syal schi'ani.
Palta tato tz'ik'jikot schik'il t'a yol mantiado t'a jun lugar to yik Jehová yaji, yuj yak'ji tup mul, max yal-laj schiji nok'. Ha jun silab' chi' yowalil snhusjitz'a smasanil.
Yik Jehová yaj silab' tz'ak'ji yuj stupchaj mul. Haton wal cheknab'il yuj tas tz'aj yak'ji tik:
Ha junok nok' nok' tz'ak'ji yuj stupchaj mul, yowalil smiljicham nok' b'aj schamtaxon nok' snhusjitz'a'ok, haxo schik'il nok' stzikji'och t'a schanhil pak'anh altar.
Tz'ak'ji masanil xepu'al nok', haton xepu' ayoch t'a nok' snhe, t'a nok' yol sk'o'ol,
yet' nok' stut schab'il yet' xepu' ayoch t'a yich spatik nok' yet' pax xepu' ayoch t'a yib'anh seyub' nok', junnhej tz'aj yel yet' nok' stut chi'.
Haxo junok heb' sacerdote snhusantz'a juntzanh chi' t'a yib'anh altar silab'il to snhusjitz'a t'a yichanh Jehová yuj stojolok mul.
Yalnhej mach heb' winak t'a yinhtilal heb' sacerdote syal schi'an jun silab' chi', palta anhej t'a jun lugar to yik Jehová yaji, yujto a jun chi' niwan yelk'ochi.
Ha cheknab'il yuj silab' yik stupchaj mul, lajannhej yet' yik silab' tz'ak'ji yuj mul. Ha nok' chib'ej yik juntzanh silab' chi', skan yikok winh sacerdote ix ak'anoch t'a yichanh Jehová.
Anhejton pax ha' stz'umal jun nok' silab' stz'a syak' heb' anima chi', yik winh sacerdote chi' tz'ajkani.
Icha pax chi' masanil ofrenda sk'anb'i t'a horno, ma t'a yol xalten, ma staji t'a yoltak niwak chen, yiknhej jun winh sacerdote tz'ak'anoch jun ofrenda chi' t'a yichanh Jehová.

Icha chi' tz'aj yak'ji masanil ofrenda tz'ak'ji t'a tas swaji, icha ixim trigo jaxb'il kalab'il yet' aceite, mato k'anb'inak. Ha juntzanh chi' yiknhej heb' yinhtilal winhaj Aarón, lajannhej tz'aj spukanek' heb' t'a spatik.
Haton wal sleyal tas tz'aj yak'ji silab' t'a yichanh Jehová sch'oxan junk'olal yet'ok:

Tato a junok nok' silab' chi' tz'ak'ji yuj ak'oj yuj diosal, tz'ak'jipax ixim pan malaj yich, skalaj yet' aceite yet' k'oxox pan tz'och aceite t'ay to malaj pax yich yet' juntzanh pan b'ob'il t'a ixim harina te wach' kalab'il yet' aceite.
Ha yet' jun silab' chi', tz'ak'jipax ixim pan ay yich.
Tz'ik'ji'el junok pan, tz'ak'ji'och t'a yichanh Jehová. Slajwi chi' skan jun pan chi' t'a yol sk'ab' winh sacerdote, haton winh stzikanem schik'il nok' silab' chi'.
Ha nok' nok' tz'ak'ji silab'il yik sch'oxan junk'olal yet' Dios yuj ak'oj yuj diosal, ha t'a jun k'uhal tz'ak'ji nok' chi' schijikanb'ati, manhxa jab'ok nok' sik'jikanb'at t'a junxo k'u.
Ha pax tato a jun silab' tz'ak'ji yujto yak'nak sti' mach yak'ani, ma tonhej tz'el t'a sk'ol yak'ani, a juntzanh chi' schiji t'a jun k'uhal chi', tato ayto nok' skani, syal schiji t'a junxo k'u.
Palta tato ayto nok' t'a schab'ji'al, hata' yowalil snhusjitz'a nok'.

Tato ay mach schi'an jun nok' silab' chi' t'a schab'ji'al, a jun silab' chi' maxtzak chajilaj, maxtzak ochpaxlaj yopisio. Ha jun chi' manh wach'ok tz'ajkan t'a yol sat Jehová. Yuj chi' a mach schi'an jun chi', skan jun mul chi' t'a yib'anh.

Tato ay nok' chib'ej yik junok silab' tik tz'och tennaj t'a junok tas manh wach'ok yaj icha yalan ley, maxtzak yal-laj schiji nok', palta to snhusjitz'a nok'. Ha mach wach' yaj icha yalan ley, syal schi'an juntzanh silab' chi'.

Ha junok anima manh wach'ok yaj icha yalan ley, yujto ix syam junok tas to manh wach'ok, wach'chom t'a anima skoti, ma junok nok' nok', ma junokxo tas manh wach'ok, tato a jun anima chi' schi'anpax nok' silab' yik junk'olal to yik Jehová yaji, a jun anima chi', manhxa'okab' yalan yik t'a ko kal, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al masanil juntzanh tik t'a heb' etchonhab': Max yal-laj he chi'an xepu'al nok' nok', nok' wakax, nok' kalnel, ma nok' chiwa,
yet' pax xepu'al nok' nok' tonhej syak'cham sb'a, ma nok' smiljicham yuj nok' kaltakte'al nok'. Syal sk'anchaj t'a junokxo tasi, palta max yal-laj schiji.
Yalnhej mach schi'an xepu'al nok' nok' to syal snhusjitz'a t'a ofrenda'il t'a Jehová, manhxa'okab' yalan yik t'a ko kal.
Yalnhej b'ajtil ayex ek'i, max yal tze chi' schik'il nok' nok', haton nok' niwak nok' yet' nok' much.
Ha junok anima schi'an schik'il nok' nok' chi', manhxa'okab' yalan yik t'a ko kal, xa chi, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al jun cheknab'il tik t'a heb' etchonhab': Ha junok mach tz'ak'an junok silab' yik sch'oxan sjunk'olal yet' Jehová, yowalil syik'kot t'a yichanh.
Ha tz'ik'ankot jab'ok nok' snhusjitz'a t'a yichanh, haton xepu'al nok' yet' nok' snhi' sk'o'ol. Ha nok' snhisk'ol chi' sb'akhchajoch t'a yichanh Jehová.
Ha nok' xepu' chi' snhusjitz'a t'a altar yuj junok sacerdote, haxo nok' snhi' sk'o'ol, yik winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal yaj nok'.
Ha xub' nok' silab' chi' t'a swach' yik winh sacerdote tz'ak'an schik'il nok' yet' xepu'al nok' t'a silab'il yuj junk'olal.

Ha nok' snhi' sk'o'ol sb'akhchajek' t'a yichanh Jehová yet' nok' xub' t'a swach', a Jehová chi' tz'ak'an nok' t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yinhtilal t'a masanil tiempo. Ha juntzanh chi' yiknhej heb' yaj t'a nok' silab' yik junk'olal syak' heb' israel chi'.
Ha t'a nok' silab' snhusjitz'a t'a yichanh Jehová, yak'nak nok' snhi' sk'o'ol yet' nok' xub' t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yinhtilal, atax t'a sk'uhal a ix sik'chajkanoch heb' t'a sacerdote'al.
Atax t'a jun k'u chi' yalnakkani to yowalil tz'ak'ji juntzanh chi' t'a heb'. Ha jun cheknab'il tik, yowalil sko k'anab'ajej t'a masanil tiempo yet' heb' kinhtilal t'a b'ak'inh.

Ichaton tik sleyal masanil juntzanh silab' tz'ak'ji t'a Dios: Haton silab' snhusjitz'a smasanil, ofrenda tz'ak'ji t'a tas swaji, silab' tz'ak'ji yuj mul yet' pax yuj stupchaj mul yet' junok mach tz'ochkan yikok Dios yet' silab' sch'oxan junk'olal yet' Dios.
Ha juntzanh ley tik ix yak' Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés t'a jolom witz Sinaí t'a tzinan lu'um, haton wal t'a jun k'u chi' ix alchaji, to ol yak' silab' heb' israel t'a Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:

Ik'kot winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal, tzik'anpaxkot spichul heb' syak'och t'a yopisio t'a sacerdote'al. Tzik'paxkot aceite sk'anchaji a sik'chajkanoch heb' t'a yopisio chi'. Tzik'paxkot junok nok' kelem wakax ol ak'chaj silab'il yuj mul yet' chawanhok nok' ch'ak kalnel yet' junok yune' mo'och ixim pan malaj yich.
Tza molb'an heb' etchonhab' smasanil t'a sti' mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, xchi t'a winh.
Ix sk'anab'ajej winhaj Moisés chi' icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová, ix molchaj anima smasanil t'a sti' mantiado chi'.
Ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: Haton juntzanh tik ix yal Jehová to ol ko k'ulej, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh to snitzkot sb'a winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal t'a stz'ey. Ix b'ikji'el heb' yuj winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix ak'ji'och skamix winhaj Aarón chi' yet' stzek'ul yuj winh yet' pax k'apak pichul jukan, k'apak chaleka yet' k'apak stzek'ul tz'isb'iloch yelwanub'.
Haxo t'a spatik k'apak chi', ix yak'paxoch jun k'apak smakul snhisk'ol winh, ha t'a yol k'apak chi' ix yak'och k'e'en Urim winh yet' k'e'en Tumim.

Ixlajwi chi' ix ak'jik'e sk'ox winh, haton jun k'apak ix b'ak'ji'och t'a sjolom winh. Haxo t'a snanhal sat winh, ix ak'ji'och jun k'e'en yelwanub' nab'a oro, haton sch'oxani to sik'b'iloch winh t'a sacerdote'al, icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'ancha'anh aceite winhaj Moisés chi', haton sk'anchaji a sik'chajoch junok mach, ma junok tas tz'ochkan yikok Jehová. Ix stzikanem winh t'a yib'anh skajnub' Jehová yet' t'a yib'anh masanil tastak ayoch t'a yo'ol chi'. Icha wal chi' ix aj yochkan masanil tastak chi' yikok Jehová.
Hanheja' jun aceite chi', ix tzikji'em ukel t'a yib'anh altar yet' t'a yib'anh masanil syamk'ab'il, t'a yib'anh jun niwan palangana yet' sb'akhnub' yich. Icha chi' ix aj yochkan yikok Jehová.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'anpaxk'e aceite winhaj Moisés t'a sjolom winhaj Aarón yuj yochkan winh yikok Jehová.
Ix yik'anpaxkot heb' yuninal winhaj Aarón chi' winh t'a stz'ey. Ix ak'ji'och spichul heb' jukan, stzek'ul heb' yet' sk'ox heb' yuj winh, icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ankot nok' kelem wakax winh, nok' ol och t'a silab'il yuj mul. Ha winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal, ix yak'k'e sk'ab' heb' t'a sjolom nok'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix smilancham nok' winh. Ix yik'anb'at schik'il nok' winh, ix sukanoch winh yet' yiximal sk'ab' t'a sch'ak altar ayk'e t'a schikintak schanhil, yik wach' chab'il yuj Dios. Haxo jantakto chik' ixto kan chi', ix stob'kanem winh t'a yichtak altar chi'. Icha chi' ix aj yochkan yikok Jehová, yik wach' slajwikanel chukal ta'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'anelta masanil xepu'al nok' winh ayoch t'a nok' yol sk'o'ol yet' t'a yib'anh seyub' nok', nok' stut schab'il yet' xepu'al ayoch t'ay. Masanil juntzanh chi' ix snhustz'a winh t'a yib'anh altar.
Haxo jantakto nok' wakax chi' ix kani, haton stz'umal nok' yet' sb'ak'chil nok' yet' sch'anhtza' nok', ix ak'chajkanoch sk'ak'al t'a spatikelta campamento, icha ix aj yalan Jehová.
Ix yak'anpax ik'jokkot nok' kalnel winh snhusjitz'a smasanil silab'il. Haxo winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal chi', ix yak'k'e sk'ab' heb' t'a sjolom nok'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix smilancham nok' winhaj Moisés chi', ix stzikanoch schik'il nok' winh t'a schanhil pak'anh altar.
Ix skotak xikej nok' winh, ix snhusantz'a sjolom nok' winh yet' nok' chok' yaj chi' yet' sxepu'al nok'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix smaxan nok' yol sk'o'ol winh yet' nok' yok. Ix snhusantz'a nok' winh smasanil silab'il t'a yib'anh altar. Ha jun ofrenda chi' te suk'uk'i sjab' ix yab' Jehová, icha wal ix aj yalani.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'an ik'jokkot junxo nok' ch'ak kalnel winh yik sk'anchaji yik tz'ochkan heb' t'a yopisio. Haxo winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal chi', ix yak'k'e sk'ab' heb' t'a sjolom nok'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix smilancham nok' winh, ix yik'anb'at jab'ok schik'il nok' winh, ix sukanoch winh t'a sjayil schikin winhaj Aarón t'a swach', t'a smam sk'ab' winh t'a swach' yet' t'a yiximal smam yok winh t'a swach'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh to snitzkot sb'a heb' yuninal winhaj Aarón chi' t'a stz'ey, ix yak'anpaxoch schik'il nok' chi' winh t'a sjayil schikin heb' t'a swach' yet' t'a smam sk'ab' heb' t'a swach' yet' t'a yiximal smam yok heb' t'a swach'. Ixlajwi chi' ix stzikanoch winh jantakto chik' ixto kan t'a schanhil pak'anh altar.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'anelta xepu' winh ayoch t'a nok' snhe yet' ayoch t'a nok' yol sk'o'ol, xepu' ayoch t'a yib'anh seyub' nok' yet' nok' stut schab'il yet' xepu' ayoch t'ay yet' nok' xub' t'a swach'.

Ix yik'ankot jun yune' mo'och ixim pan winh malaj yich, ix yak'och winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Ix yik'ank'eta jun ixim pan chi' winh t'a yol mo'och chi' yet' junxo ixim kalab'il yet' aceite yet' jun ixim k'oxox b'ob'il t'a ixim harina, ix yak'ank'e winh t'a yib'anh nok' xepu' chi' yet' t'a yib'anh nok' xub' t'a swach'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'an masanil juntzanh tik winh t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal, yik sb'akhanek' heb' t'a yichanh Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'anpaxek' masanil juntzanh chi' winh t'a yol sk'ab' heb', ix snhusantz'a winh smasanil t'a yib'anh altar yet' nok' silab' ix nhusjitz'a t'a yichanh Jehová, yuj sik'chajoch heb' t'a yopisio. Te suk'uk'i sjab' ix yab' Jehová.
Ix yik'anpaxkot snhisk'ol nok' kalnel winh ix ak'ji yuj sik'chajkanoch heb' t'a yopisio. Ix sb'akhanoch heb' t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha jun chi' ix yik'kan winhaj Moisés chi' icha ix aj yalan Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ankot aceite winh yet' chik' ayek' t'a yib'anh altar. Ix stzikank'e winh t'a yib'anh winhaj Aarón yet' t'a spichul. Ix tzikanpaxk'e winh t'a yib'anh heb' yuninal winhaj Aarón chi' yet' t'a spichul heb'. Icha chi' ix aj yochkan heb' yikok Jehová yet' spichul smasanil.

Ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yuninal chi': Tz'anhjokab' nok' chib'ej t'a yichanh mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová. Hata' tze chi nok' yet' ixim pan ayem t'a yol jun yune' mo'och, haton ixim ix ak'ji yik tzex ochkan t'a eyopisio. Icha ix aj walani: Ha winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal ol swa jun wa'el tik heb', xin chi, ix walani.
Ha jantakto manh ol lajwok nok' chib'ej chi' yet' ixim pan chi' eyu'uj, ol he nhuskantz'a'ok.
Ha t'a yichanh k'apak mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová, anhej ta' tzex aj uke'ok k'uhal masanto sk'och sk'uhal eyochkan t'a eyopisio.
Ha tikne'ik toxo ix b'o icha wal ix aj schekan Jehová ko k'ulej yik slajwikanel he mul.

Yuj chi' ha t'a yichanh mantiado, hata' tzex kan uke'ok k'uhal yet' uke'ok ak'wal. Tze k'anab'ajan masanil juntzanh scheknab'il Jehová yik wach' max ex chami, yujto icha chi' ix aj yalan Jehová chi' t'ayin, xchi winh t'a heb'.
Icha chi' ix aj sk'anab'ajan winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal masanil tas ix schek Jehová yal winhaj Moisés chi' t'a heb'.
T'a yewi'al slajwi uke' k'uhal yochkan winhaj Aarón t'a yopisio chi', ix awtaj winh yet' heb' yuninal yet' heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' yuj winhaj Moisés.

Ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Aarón chi': Ik'kot junok nok' kelem wakax yik tz'och nok' silab'il yuj a mul yet' junok nok' ch'ak kalnel, haton nok' malaj jab'ok spalta'il. Tza nhustz'a smasanil silab'il u'uj, tzak'och nok' t'a yichanh Jehová.

Alpax t'a heb' ketisraelal to syik'kot junok nok' mam chiwa heb' silab'il yuj smul. Syik'anpaxkot junok nok' kelem wakax heb' yet' junok nok' kalnel, yuj snhusjitz'a nok' smasanil silab'il, jun ab'il sk'inal junjun nok', malajokab' jab'ok spalta'il nok'.

Syik'anpaxkot junok nok' wakax heb' yet' junok nok' ch'ak kalnel smiljicham t'a yichanh Jehová silab'il yik sch'oxan sjunk'olal heb' yet'ok. Syik'anpaxkot junok ofrenda heb' t'a tas swaji, kalab'il yet' aceite, yujto ol sch'ox sb'a Jehová t'ayex tikne'ik, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yik'ankot heb' t'a yichanh mantiado masanil tastak ix chekji yik'kot yuj winhaj Moisés chi'. Masanil chonhab' ix jawi molan, ix och linhjab' heb' t'a yichanh Jehová.
Haxo ix yalan winhaj Moisés chi' t'a heb' icha tik: Haton wal juntzanh tik schek Jehová he k'ulej yik wach' ol sch'ox wal stzikiki'al t'ayex, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanxi winh t'a winhaj Aarón chi': Nitzkot a b'a t'a slak'anil altar tik, tzak'an nok' nok' silab'ok yuj a mul yet' nok' silab' snhusjitz'a smasanil. Icha chi' ol aj yak'ji lajwok a mul. Tzak'anpax nok' silab' yuj yak'ji lajwok ko mul a onh israel onh tik, icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix jawi winhaj Aarón t'a slak'anil altar chi', ix smilancham nok' kelem wakax ix yak' winh silab'il yuj smul chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix japax heb' yuninal winh yet' schik'il nok' silab' chi', ix yak'anem yiximal sk'ab' winh t'a skal chik' chi', ix sukanoch winh t'a sch'ak altar chi'. Haxo jab'okxo chik' ixto kan chi', ix sekkanem winh t'a yich altar chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix snhusantz'a smasanil xepu'al nok' winh t'a yib'anh altar yet' pax stut nok' yet' xepu'al ayoch t'a yib'anh seyub' nok', haton nok' silab' yuj mul, icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Haxo pax sb'ak'chil nok' yet' stz'umal, ix nhusjitz'a t'a spatikel campamento.
Ix smilanpaxcham nok' silab' winhaj Aarón chi', nok' snhusjitz'a smasanil, haxo heb' yuninal winh ix ik'ankot schik'il nok', ix stzikanoch winh t'a schanhil pak'anh altar.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'anpaxkot sjolom nok' heb' yet' nok' ix xikchajb'at chi', ix snhusantz'a winh t'a yib'anh altar chi'.
Ix maxchaj nok' yol sk'o'ol yet' nok' yok, ix snhusanpaxtz'a winh t'a yib'anh altar chi', t'a yib'anh nok' wanxo stz'a chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an silab' winh yuj heb' yetchonhab'. Ix yik'ankot nok' chiwa winh, haton nok' silab' tz'ak'ji yuj smul heb' yetchonhab' chi'. Ix smilancham nok' winh, ix yak'an nok' winh silab'il icha ix yutej yak'an nok' b'ab'el chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an junxo nok' silab' winh to stz'a smasanil icha sleyal.
Ix yak'anpax ofrenda winh t'a tas swaji. Ix yik'b'at jun b'echanh ixim harina winh, ix snhusantz'a winh t'a yib'anh altar yet' silab' snhusjitz'a t'a junjun k'inhib'alil.

Ix yak'anpax nok' wakax winh yet' nok' ch'ak kalnel ix yik'kot heb' yetchonhab' chi' silab'il yuj sch'oxan sjunk'olal heb' yet' Dios. Ha heb' yuninal winh ix ik'ankot schik'il nok', haxo winh ix tzikanoch t'a schanhil pak'anh altar chi'.
Ix yak'anpax xepu'al nok' wakax heb' yet' xepu'al nok' ch'ak kalnel chi', haton xepu' ayoch t'a snhe nok', t'a nok' yol sk'o'ol yet' t'a nok' stut yet' xepu' ayoch t'a yib'anh seyub' nok'.
Junnhej ix aj nok' xepu' chi' yet' nok' snhi' sk'o'ol. Haxo winhaj Aarón ix nhusantz'a nok' xepu'al chi' t'a yib'anh altar.
Haxo pax nok' snhisk'ol chi' yet' nok' xub' t'a swach', tonhej ix b'akhji'ek' t'a yichanh Jehová, icha ix aj yalan winhaj Moisés chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'ancha'anh sk'ab' winhaj Aarón chi', ix yalan wach' lolonel winh t'a yib'anh heb' yetchonhab' chi'. Ayik toxo ix lajwi snhusantz'a silab' winh yuj mul yet' silab' snhusjitz'a smasanil yet' silab' yik sch'oxan sjunk'olal yet' Dios, ix emixta winh b'aj ay altar chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix och winhaj Moisés yet' winh t'a mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová. Haxo ix elta heb' winh, ix yalan wach' lolonel heb' winh t'a yib'anh heb' yetchonhab' chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix sch'oxan stzikiki'al Jehová t'a masanil heb' israel chi'.

Ix elta k'ak' t'a yichanh Jehová chi', ix snhusantz'a nok' silab' yet' xepu'al nok' ayk'e t'a yib'anh altar, ix tz'ab'at smasanil. Ha ix yilan masanil jun chi' heb' chonhab' chi', ix el yaw heb' t'a tzalajk'olal, ix em nhojjab' heb', ix emk'och snanhal sat heb' t'a sat lu'um.

Ha winhaj Nadab yet' winhaj Abiú, heb' winh yuninal winhaj Aarón, ix yik'kot junjun chaynub' yik incienso heb' winh, ix yak'anoch sk'ak'al heb' winh, ix yak'anpaxem incienso heb' winh t'a yib'anh, ix yak'anoch heb' winh t'a yichanh Jehová, to manhoklaj ix halani.
Yuj chi' ix elta k'ak' t'a yichanh Jehová chi' t'a heb' winh, ix tz'ab'at heb' winh, ix cham heb' winh t'a yichanh Jehová chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Moisés chi' t'a winhaj Aarón: --Haton jun tik syalelk'och slolonel Jehová ix yala': Ha yuj heb' tzin ak'an serwil, ol in ch'ox in b'a, to Ha inxonhej ochi. Ha t'a masanil in chonhab' ol in ch'ox in tzikiki'al, xchi Jehová, xchi winh. Ix em numnaj winhaj Aarón chi', manhxalaj tas ix yal winh.

Ixlajwi chi', haxo winhaj Moisés chi' ix awtan winhaj Misael yet' winhaj Elzafán, heb' yuninal winhaj Uziel yicham winhaj Aarón chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh: --Nitzekkot he b'a a ex tik t'a sti' mantiado b'aj ayek' sniwanil heb' he k'ab' eyok chi', ik'ekel heb' t'a spatikel campamento, xchi winh.

Ix jawi heb' winh, ix yik'anel heb' chamnak chi' heb' winh t'a spatikel campamento icha ix aj yalan winhaj Moisés chi'. Ayto'och spichul heb' chamnak chi' t'ay, haton k'apak sk'antaxon heb' t'a yopisio.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Moisés t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a chawanhxo heb' yuninal winh, haton winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Itamar: --Manh eyik'el he k'ox ayk'e t'a he jolom, manh he nhik'chitejb'at he pichul yuj he ch'oxanel he kusk'olal. Haxo talaj tz'aji, tzex champaxi, haxo skot yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a kib'anh ko masanil a onh israel onh tik. Palta a masanil heb' ketchonhab' tik syal yok' sk'ol heb' yuj mach ix satel Jehová yet' k'ak'.

Manh ex elpax t'a yichanh mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová yik wach' manh ol ex chamok, a ex tik sik'b'il ex eli, ak'b'iloch aceite to yik Jehová t'ayex, xchi winh. Icha wal ix aj yalan winhaj Moisés chi', icha chi' ix sk'ulej heb'.
Ix yalanpax Jehová t'a winhaj Aarón chi' icha tik:

--Ayik ol ach och a ach tik, ma heb' uninal t'a yol mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, manh eyuk' wino, ma tastak pajb'inakxo, haxo talaj tz'aji tzex chami. Ha jun tik ley tz'ajkan t'a he kal t'a masanil tiempo.
Manh he k'ulej juntzanh chi' yujto yowalil snachajel eyu'uj, tastak wach' icha yalan ley yet' tastak manh wach'ok.
Yowalil tze k'ayb'ejpax heb' eyetchonhab' t'a juntzanh ley ix in chek yal winhaj Moisés t'ayex tik, xchi t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalanpax winhaj Moisés chi' t'a winhaj Aarón yet' pax t'a heb' yuninal winh, haton winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Itamar: --Ik'ekkot ixim harina ixto kan t'a ofrenda ix tz'a t'a yichanh Jehová, tze b'o'an ixim pan malaj yich t'a yichanh altar, yujto a jun ofrenda chi' yik Jehová yaji.
Tze wa'an t'a junok lugar to yik Jehová yaji, yujto a ofrenda snhusjitz'a t'a yichanh Jehová ik yaj yet' heb' uninal. Haton juntzanh tik ix alji t'ayin.

Haxo pax nok' snhisk'ol sb'akhchajek' t'a yichanh Jehová yet' nok' xub', tz'ik'chajel nok', a juntzanh chi' eyiktaxon yaji. Tza chi yet' heb' uninal yet' heb' isil t'a junok lugar to wach' yaji icha syal ley, yujto a juntzanh chi' eyiktaxon yaj t'a silab' sch'oxan sjunk'olal heb' ketchonhab' yet' Dios.

Yujto a nok' xub' tz'ik'ji'el chi' yet' nok' snhisk'ol sb'akhji'ek' t'a yichanh Jehová, junnhej tz'aj yak'ji yet' nok' xepu' snhusjitz'a'ok. Ha cha makan nok' chi', ik yet' heb' uninal t'a masanil tiempo icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'ayin, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.

Ix sk'anb'anpax winhaj Moisés chi' yuj nok' chiwa ix ak'ji silab'il yuj mul. Haxo ix yalan heb' winh to toxo ix snhustz'a nok' heb' winh. Yuj chi' ix kot yowal winh t'a winhaj Eleazar yet' t'a winhaj Itamar, ix yalan winh icha tik:

--¿Tas yuj maj he chi nok' silab' t'a yamak'il skajnub' Jehová? Ha jun makan silab' chi', yik Jehová yaji, yuj chi' ix ak'ji t'ayex, yuj he chi'an nok', yik tz'ik'ji'el smul heb' molanek' t'a yichanh Jehová.
Yujto a schik'il nok' silab' chi', maj ik'jib'at t'a yol skajnub' Jehová, yuj chi' yowalil to ix he chi nok' t'a yamak'il chi', icha ix aj walan t'ayex, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Aarón icha tik: --Ha tikne'ik ix yak' silab' heb' yuj smul yet' silab' to stz'a smasanil, wach'chom icha chi', palta ina wal tas ix jawi t'a wib'anh. Tato ix in chi nok' silab' ix ak'ji yuj mul chi', ¿tom chab'il in yuj Jehová tza na'? xchi winhaj Aarón chi'.
Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Moisés icha chi', ix scha'an sk'ol winh.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón icha tik:
Alek t'a masanil heb' eyetchonhab' to ha t'a skal masanil nok' nok' ay t'a sat lu'um tik, haton juntzanh nok' tik syal he chi'ani:
Nok' sjax yanh cha xechanh yech.

Palta a juntzanhxo nok' ol wal tik, manh ol yal-laj he chi'an nok', wach'chom sjax yanh nok', palta manh cha xechanhok yech nok': Nok' camello sjax yanh nok', palta manh cha xechanhok yech nok', a nok' chi' max yal-laj he chi'an nok'.
Yet' pax nok' tejón, sjax yanh nok', palta tzijtum yech nok', a nok' chi' max yal-laj he chi'an nok'.
Yet' pax nok' niwak chich, sjax yanh nok', palta tzijtum yech nok', yuj chi' max yal-laj he chi'an nok'.
Yet' pax nok' chitam, wach'chom cha xechanh yech nok', palta max sjaxpax swa'el nok', yuj chi' max yal-laj he chi'an nok'.
Max yal he chi'an juntzanh nok' nok' chi', max yalpax eyaman nok' ayik toxo ix cham nok', yowalil tze na'a to manh wach'ok nok' icha yalan ley.
Haxo pax nok' ay t'a yoltak ha ha', nok' ay t'a yol ha' mar, ma t'a yoltak a niwak ha', syal he chi'an nok' ay sk'axil yet' stuminal spatik.
Haxo pax nok' malaj sk'axil, malaj pax stuminal spatik, max yal-laj he chi'an nok'. Ha nok' chi' yajb'entak nok', wach'chom ha t'a yol ha' mar ma t'a yoltak ha' ay nok'.
Yujto yajb'entak nok', manh he chi nok', manh eyampax nok' chamnakxo.
Masanil nok' malaj sk'axil yet' stuminal spatik ay t'a yoltak ha', yajb'entakokab' yaj nok' t'a yol he sat.
Hanheja' pax t'a skal nok' much, manh ol yal-laj he chi'an juntzanh nok' ol wal tik, yujto manh wach'ok nok': Icha nok' t'iw, nok' wakawok, nok' ch'akb'a yik ha ha',
nok' xulem, nok' milano yet' masanil makanhil nok' xulem chi',
yet' masanil makanhil nok' joj,
nok' avestruz, nok' niwak tonton, nok' xalunhe yet' masanil makanhil nok' ch'akb'a,
nok' kujub', nok' kormorán, nok' ibis,
nok' pech, nok' julum chay, nok' ostok,
nok' cigüeña yet' masanil makanhil nok' garza yet' nok' abubilla yet' nok' sotz'.
Hanhejtona' pax masanil nok' kotak nok' tzek' jenhenhok t'a jun petanhil sb'ey t'a sat lu'um, yajb'entakokab' nok' t'a yol he sat.
Haxo pax tato a nok' ay yip yok sk'e tz'itnajok, wach'chom sjenhwi nok', sb'eypax nok' t'a sat lu'um, syal schiji nok'.
Ha t'a skal nok' chi' syal he chi'an smasanil makanhil nok' k'ulub', nok' niwak k'ulub' yet' nok' chil.
Haxo masanil juntzanhxo nok' kotakil nok' tzek' jenhenhok, ma tzek' t'a sat lu'um tik, yowalil tzeyaj nok'.

Tato tze yam juntzanh nok' nok' swal tik ayik chamnakxo nok', manh wach'ok tzex ajkani icha yalan ley, masanto sk'ik'b'i'emi. Masanil nok' nok' ay yech palta manh chaxechanhoklaj, max sjaxpax yanh, a juntzanh nok' chi' nachajokab' el eyu'uj to manh wach'ok nok'. Yalnhej tas nok'al to chanhe' yok palta tzijtum yech mokab' wach'ok nok' t'a yol he sat. Yuj chi' yalnhej mach syaman junok nok' nok' chi' tato chamnakxo nok', manh wach'ok tz'ajkani, icha yalan ley. Icha pax chi' junok mach tz'ik'ancha'anh nok' chamnak nok' chi', yowalil sjuk'el spichul, palta manto wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sk'ik'b'i'emi. Manh wach'ok juntzanh nok' chi' icha yalan ley.

Haxo masanil nok' nok' tzek' t'a sat lu'um, nachajokab' el eyu'uj to max yal schiji juntzanh nok' tik: Icha nok' k'uxum boton, nok' ch'o'ow, nok' k'ok'on yet' masanil makanhil nok' pajtza' yet' masanil makanhil nok' tzek' nhernhonok ma tzek' jachjonok: Haton nok' ayin, nok' lagarto, nok' patix yet' nok' tzalajk'ab'.

Ha t'a skal masanil nok' nok', a juntzanh nok' tik, nachajokab' el eyu'uj to manh wach'ok nok' icha yalan ley, yuj chi' yalnhej mach syaman nok' ayik toxo ix cham nok', manh wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sk'ik'b'i'emi.

K'inalok ay junok tas b'aj tz'em nok' chamnak nok' chi', a jun chi', manh wach'ok tz'ajkani, icha yalan ley: Wach'chom a junok te te', junok pichul, junok tz'u'um, junok koxtal, ma junok yamk'ab' yik munlajel, tato tz'em junok nok' chamnak nok' chi' t'a yib'anh, yowalil slab'chajem t'a skal ha ha'. Palta manto wach'ok tz'ajkani, masanto sk'ik'b'i'emi, ichato chi' wach' tz'ajkani.
Tato tz'em junok nok' nok' chi' t'a yol junok lum chen ayik toxo ix cham nok', a tas ayem t'a yol lum chi', manh wach'ok tz'ajkani, haxo jun chen chi', yowalil smak'jipoj lu'um.
Yalnhej tas chib'il wa'ilal yet' yal ayem t'a yol jun chen chi', ma uk'em, manh wach'ok tz'ajkani.

Yuj chi' tato tz'em junok nok' chamnak nok' chi' t'a yib'anh junok tasi, manh wach'ok tz'ajkani, wach'chom a junok horno, ma junok yet'tal b'aj tz'och k'ak', yowalil spojji'eli. Ha jun yamk'ab' chi' manhxo wach'ok icha yalan ley, yuj chi' manhxo wach'ok pax t'a yol he sat.
Palta a sjaj ha ha', ma ha' uk'b'ila' wach'chom tz'em nok' chamnak nok' t'a yol ha', wach'nhej yaj ha', anhej jun mach tz'ik'ank'eta nok' chamnak nok' chi' t'a yol ha' manh wach'ok tz'ajkani.
K'inalok tz'em junok nok' chamnak nok' chi' t'a yib'anh junok makan inhat tz'awchaji, a jun makan inhat chi' max ixtaxel-laj.
Palta tato a jun makan inhat lab'anxo, tz'em junok chamnak nok' chi' t'a yib'anh, a juntzanh inhat chi' manhxo wach'ok tz'ajkani.
K'inalok scham junok nok' nok' to schiji, a mach syaman nok', manh wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sk'ik'b'ikanemi.

Ha mach schi'an sb'ak'chil nok' chamnak nok' chi' yowalil sjuk'el spichul, manh wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sk'ik'b'ikanemi. Ha mach tz'ik'anelta junok chamnak nok' chi' yowalil sjuk'el spichul, manh wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sk'ik'b'i'emi.
Manh he chi juntzanh nok' nok' snherwi, ma sjachwi t'a sat lu'um, yujto manh wach'ok nok'.

Masanil nok' nok' snherwi, ma sjachwi t'a sat lu'um, wach'chom nok' sb'ey yet' schanhil yok, ma nok' tzijtum yok, masanil juntzanh nok' chi' manh wach'ok nok' icha yalan ley, yuj chi' manh he chi nok'.
Manh he ju'el he b'a a ex tik yuj nok' nok' manh wach'ok chi', yujto manh wach'ok tzex ajkan yuj nok'.
Ha in ton Jehová he Diosal in, yuj chi' b'esekel he b'a t'a juntzanh manh wach'ok chi', yujto wach' innhej, yuj chi' te max yal eyixtanb'at he b'a yet' juntzanh nok' chi'.
Ha in Jehová in, ix ex wik'elta t'a Egipto, he Diosal in, yuj chi' te wach'okab'nhej tzeyutej he b'a yujto wach' innhej.
Haton wal masanil juntzanh cheknab'il tik t'a masanil nok' nok', nok' much yet' masanil nok' nok' ay t'a yoltak ha ha' yet' masanil nok' tzek' jachachok t'a sat lu'um tik, swal t'ayex
yik wach' snachajel eyu'uj b'ajtil ay nok' wach' syal schiji yet' nok' manh wach'ok max yal schiji, xchi Jehová, xe chi.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés icha tik:
Al masanil juntzanh tik t'a heb' etisraelal: Tato a junok ix ix tz'aj junok swinak unin, yowalil uke' k'uhal manh sakok yaj ix icha sleyal, ichataxon yik syilan sb'islab' uj ix t'a juntak el.
T'a wal yukub'ixi'al yaj jun winak unin chi', tz'ak'ji circuncidar.

Haxo pax ix nunab'il chi', 33 k'uhalto manh wach'ok tz'ajkan ix, ichato wanto sakb'itan sb'a ix, max yal-laj syaman junok tas ix to wik yaji, max yalpax sb'at ix b'aj ay in kajnub' ayik manto tz'akwok juntzanh k'uhal chi'.
Palta tato ix unin tz'aj jun, 14 k'uhal tz'ek'i ayik manto sakok yaj ix, ichataxon tz'aj t'a sb'islab' uj t'a juntak el, slajwi chi' 66 k'uhal skan ix yik sakb'itan sb'a.

Ayik stz'akwi juntzanh k'uhal yik sakb'itan sb'a ix yuj yune' ix alji chi', wach'chom winak unin ma ix unin, yowalil syik'kot junok nok' kelem kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal ix silab'il yet' junok nok' yalnhej makanhil paramuch, syak' ix silab'il yuj yak'ji tup smul. Ha juntzanh chi' tz'ak'ji t'a junok winh sacerdote t'a yichanh mantiado.
Haxo jun winh sacerdote chi' tz'ak'an t'ayin silab'il yik wach' tz'ak'ji tup smul ix. Icha chi' tz'aj sakb'ixikan ix. Haton juntzanh sleyal tik ayik tz'alji winak unin, ma ix unin.

Palta tato a ix nunab'il chi' malaj junok nok' skalnel chi' syal yak'ani, syik'kot chawanhok nok' paramuch ix yalnhej tas makanhil, jun nok' stz'a silab'il, jun nok' tz'ak'ji silab'il yuj yak'ji tup mul. Haxo junok winh sacerdote tz'ak'an silab'il yik wach' tz'ak'ji tup smul ix. Icha chi' tz'aj sakb'ixikan ix, xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón:

Tato ay junok anima smalk'e sniwanil, ma sk'e wochjab', ma chak sulinak tz'aj yilji sniwanil, talaj lepra jun yab'il chi', yowalil tz'ik'jikot t'a winhaj Aarón, ma t'a juntzanhokxo heb' sacerdote yinhtilal winh.

Haxo winh sacerdote chi' tz'ilan jun yab'il chi'. Tato a xi'il b'aj ay jun yab'il chi', sakxo, ma niwan chekel to manhoknhej t'a stz'umal ay jun yab'il chi', palta julxo yich, a jun yab'il chi' lepraxo. Ayik toxo ix ilji jun anima chi' yuj winh sacerdote, a winh tz'alani to maxtzak yal-laj yajek' jun anima chi' t'a skal yetanima'il.
Tato sakxo yilji stz'umal b'aj ay jun yab'il chi', palta to anhej t'a stz'umal ayochi, manh sakok pax xi'il chi' ta', yowalil smakchaj jun anima chi' yuj winh sacerdote chi' uke'ok k'uhal.
Haxo slajwi uke' k'uhal chi', sayjixi iljok jun anima chi'. Tato a jun yab'il chi' hanheja' max b'eyb'ati, smakchajxi uke'okxo k'uhal.

Ayik slajwi ukexo k'uhal chi', sayjixi iljok jun anima chi' yuj winh sacerdote chi'. Tato a jun yab'il chi' wanxo sateli, maxtzak b'eyb'at t'a stz'umal jun anima chi', ichato chi' syalan winh sacerdote chi' to manh lepra'ok tz'ik'ani, komon yab'ilnhej. Slajwi chi' sjuk'anel spichul jun pena'ay chi', wach'xo tz'ajxikani.
Palta tato a jun yab'il t'a sniwanil junok anima chi' sb'at lheb'eb'ok, wach'chom toxo ix yal winh sacerdote to manh lepra'ok, yowalil skotxi t'a winh sacerdote chi' yik sayanxi yil winh.
Tato a syilan winh sacerdote chi' to wan sb'at lheb'eb'ok jun yab'il chi', syal winh to a jun yab'il chi' lepra toni.
Tato ay junok anima ay lepra t'ay, yowalil tz'ik'jikot t'a winh sacerdote.
Ha winh sacerdote chi' tz'ilani tato wan smalk'e'i, sakxo yilji sat chi', wanxo pax sakb'i xi'il t'a sat chi', chekelxo sb'ak'chil.

Tato icha chi', haton jun chi' skuchan lepra, kotak skal sch'oxank'e sb'a t'a stz'umal chi', yuj chi' syalan winh sacerdote chi' to maxtzak yal-laj yajek' t'a skal heb' yetanima'il. Manhxo yowalilok smakchaj t'a uke'okxo k'uhal.
Tato elanhchamel sb'at lheb'naj jun yab'il chi', smajel sniwanil chi' yuj, hato ha' tz'aj yilanoch winh sacerdote chi',
ayik slajwi yilan winh, tato toxo ix majel sniwanil chi', sakxonhej yilji jun anima chi', syalan winh to manhxalaj smay.
Tato ay junok k'uhal scheklajk'e sb'ak'chil t'a skal jun yab'il chi', maxtzak yal-laj yajek' jun anima chi' t'a skal heb' yetanima'il.
Haxo winh sacerdote tz'ilan jun yab'il chi', tato ay b'aj tz'el tochnaj stz'umal ichnhej ta', syalan winh to lepra tz'ik'ani, maxtzak yal-laj yajek' t'a skal heb' yetanima'il.
Palta tato sakb'ixi'el b'aj ix el tochnaj chi', yowalil skot jun anima chi' t'a winh sacerdote,
yik wach' say yil winh. Ha winh sacerdote chi' tz'ilani tato sakxo yilji jun yab'il chi', syalan winh to manhxalaj smay jun yab'il chi'.
Tato ay mach ayk'e junok yab'il mal t'ay, stakjixi'emi,
haxo t'a sat chi' smali, sak yilji, ma chak sulinak yilji, a jun chi' yowalil skot t'a yichanh winh sacerdote.

Haxo winh sacerdote chi' tz'ilani, tato manhoknhej t'a stz'umal ayoch jun yab'il chi', tato sakxo xi'il t'a sat jun yab'il chi', a winh tz'alani to lepra jun yab'il chi', yuj chi' maxtzak yal-laj yajek' jun anima chi' t'a skal heb' yetanima'il.
Tato syil winh sacerdote chi', to max sakb'ilaj xi'il b'aj ay sat chi' to t'a satnhej stz'umal ayochi, wanxo stakji, a jun anima chi' yowalil smakchaj uke'ok k'uhal.

Ayik slajwi uke' k'uhal chi', tato yelk'olalnhej sb'at lheb'eb'ok jun yab'il chi' t'a stz'umal jun anima chi', syalan winh sacerdote chi' to lepra tz'ik'ani, maxtzak yal-laj yajek' t'a skal heb' yetanima'il.
Palta tato max b'at lheb'eb'ok jun yab'il chi', syalelk'ochi to anhej sjech'al aykani, syalan winh sacerdote chi' to manhxalaj smay jun yab'il chi'.

K'inalok ay junok mach ay yaxk'a t'a sniwanil, tato scheklaj sb'ak'chil jun anima b'aj ay yaxk'a chi', haxo t'a sb'ak'chil chi' scheklajpaxk'e junok setanh saksak, ma chak sulinak to sb'at lheb'eb'ok.

Ha winh sacerdote tz'ilani, tato a xi'il wanxo sakb'i, wanxo sb'at yich jun setanh b'aj ay sat chi', tato icha chi', lepra ix cheklajk'e b'aj ay yaxk'a chi', haxo winh sacerdote chi' tz'alani to maxtzak yal-laj yajek' jun anima chi' t'a skal heb' yetanima'il.
Tato a syilan winh sacerdote to malaj junok xil wan sakb'i'eli, to manh wanok sb'at yich jun yab'il chi', palta to wan stakji'emi, yowalil smakchaj jun anima chi' t'a uke'ok k'uhal.
Slajwi chi', sayanxi yil winh sacerdote chi', tato toxo ix b'at lheb'eb'ok t'a sniwanil jun anima chi', syalan winh to lepra tz'ik'ani, maxtzak yal-laj yajek' t'a skal heb' yetanima'il.
Palta tato a b'aj setkixtak chi', wa'anochi, wanxo sb'oxi, tonhej smal yuj b'aj stz'a'i, syalan winh sacerdote chi' to a jun yab'il chi' malaj smay, anhej sjech'al b'aj stz'a chi' skani.
Tato ha t'a junok winak ma t'a junok ix ix sk'e yab'il yaxk'a t'a sjolom, ma t'a yuk'ti',
a winh sacerdote yowalil sayan yil jun chi'. Tato a jun yab'il chi' wan sb'at yich, mato wan sk'anb'i'el xi'il yuj, syalan winh sacerdote chi' to lepra jun ayoch chi' t'a jun anima chi'.
Palta tato max b'atlaj yich jun yab'il chi', manh k'ik'ok wal xi'il b'aj ay yab'il chi', yowalil smakchaj jun anima chi' uke'ok k'uhal.
Haxo slajwi uke' k'uhal chi', sayanxi yil winh sacerdote chi', maxtzak b'atlaj lheb'eb'ok jun yab'il chi', malaj yich, max k'anb'i'el-laj xi'il,
syalan winh to sjoxji'el stitak yab'il, palta max joxji'el-laj t'a sat yab'il, smakchaj uke'okxo k'uhal jun anima chi'.

Haxo yik toxo ix ek'b'at ukexo k'uhal chi', sayanxi yil winh sacerdote chi'. Tato max b'at lheb'eb'ok, max b'at yich yuj, syalan winh to malaj smay jun yab'il chi', anhej to sjuk'el spichul jun anima chi', wach' tz'ajxikani.
Palta tato ayik toxo ix alchaji to wach' sk'ol jun anima chi', sb'atxi lheb'eb'ok jun yab'il chi',
yowalil sayxi yil winh sacerdote chi'. Tato a jun yab'il chi' wan sb'at lheb'eb'ok t'a stz'umal, manh yowalilok k'an yilji xi'il, lepra tz'ik'ani.
Palta tato wanxo stakji, k'ik' skotxi xi'il, a winh sacerdote chi' tz'alani to wach'xo sk'ol jun anima chi'.
Tato a junok winak ma junok ix ix setkixtak saksak t'a stz'umal,
a winh sacerdote tz'ilan stz'umal chi', tato saktak wal yilji, palta manh kopopi'oklaj, komon yab'il tz'ik'an jun anima chi' syal chi', malaj smay.
Tato ay junok winak sk'ajb'anel xil sjolom ma anhej t'a snanhal sat sk'ajb'anel xi'il, manhxalaj xi'il skani, a jun chi' malaj smay.

Palta tato sk'e junok yab'il yaxk'a b'aj manhxalaj xi'il chi', yowalil syil winh sacerdote. Tato chak sulinak yilji jun yaxk'a chi' icha yab'il lepra, haton lepra ayoch t'ay. Syalan winh sacerdote chi' to a jun anima chi', maxtzak yal-laj yajek' t'a skal yetanima'il yuj jun yab'il chi'.

Ha mach pena'ay yuj lepra, yowalil a pichul nhik'chimtak syak'ochi, malaj smusil sjolom syak'k'e'i, smusan nanhalok sat. Tato sb'at t'a skal anima, tz'el yaw, syalan icha tik: Elanhek, chuk waji, chuk waji, xchi.
Ayik ayoch jun yab'il chi' t'ay, yowalil sch'okoj tz'aj t'a spatikel campamento.
Ayik k'ustumtak yilji junok pichul lana, ma lino,
yalnhej tas makanhil, pach'uch'ab'il, ma jalb'il, ma junok tz'u'um to yamk'ab' yaji,

tato ya'ax yilji, ma chakchak yilji juntzanh sk'ustumtakil chi', haton jun makan to tz'el lheb'eb'ok. Ha jun chi' yowalil sch'oxji t'a winh sacerdote yik syilan jun setanh sk'ustumtakil chi' winh, smakchaj jun chi' uke'ok k'uhal.

Haxo slajwi uke' k'uhal chi', tz'iljixi. Tato toxo ix b'at lheb'eb'ok t'a jun pichul chi', ma t'a junok tz'um sk'anji chi', a jun chi' haton juntzanh k'ustumtak tz'el lheb'eb'ok, a juntzanh yamk'ab' chi' ay smay.
Yalnhej tas yamk'ab'il to ayxo jun chi' t'ay, yowalil snhusjitz'a smasanil, yujto a jun chi' tzijtum tas syixtejb'ati.
Palta tato ayik syilan winh sacerdote chi' to max b'eylaj juntzanh sk'ustumtakil chi',
syalan winh to sjuk'chajel jun yamk'ab' chi', smakchajkan uke'okxo k'uhal.

Ayik toxo ix juk'chajel jun yamk'ab' chi', ichato chi' syilanxi winh sacerdote chi'. Tato max k'exmaj yilji jun setanh sk'ustumtakil chi', wach'chom max el lheb'eb'ok, yowalil snhusjitz'a'ok, wach'chom a jun sk'ustumtakil chi' ayoch t'a spatik ma t'a yo'ol, yujto yelxo ay smay jun chi'.
Tato a syilan winh sacerdote chi' ayik toxo ix juk'chajel chi', wanxo satel jun sk'ustumtakil chi', slot'chajel b'aj ayoch chi'.
Palta tato scheklajxik'e sk'ustumtakil jun chi', yowalil snhusjitz'a'ok.
Ha juntzanh tastak b'aj satel juntzanh k'ustumtak chi' ayik sjuk'chajeli, yowalil sjuk'chajel junelxo, icha chi' syal sk'anchajxi.

Haton juntzanh cheknab'il tik t'a k'ustum tz'och t'a junok pichul pach'uch'ab'il, ma jalb'il, lana, ma lino, ma junok tz'u'um. Icha chi' tz'aj scheklajkaneli tato wach' yaji, mato manh wach'ok yaji, xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón chi'.
Ix schek Jehová yal juntzanh ley tik winhaj Moisés, ix yalani:

Haton wal jun ley tik sk'anab'ajej junok anima ek'nak lepra t'ay: Ayik sna'ani to ix b'oxi sk'o'ol, yowalil syawtej winh sacerdote t'a spatikel campamento chi' yik syilan winh tato manhxa lepra chi' t'ay. Tato syil winh sacerdote chi' to toxo ix el jun yab'il chi', schekan winh ik'chajkot chawanhok nok' much t'a spitzanil, haton nok' wach' icha yalan ley. Skotpax jab'ok te' k'ute', lana ch'al k'ik' schakil yet' te' hisopo.
Schekan miljokcham junok nok' much chi' winh sacerdote t'a yib'anh ha ha' ayem t'a yol junok lum chen, haton ha' skot b'aj sk'e'ul sjaj junok ha ha'.
Slajwi chi' tz'ik'jikot junxo nok' much chi' t'a spitzanil, te' k'ute' yet' lana ch'al k'ik' schakil yet' te' hisopo, slab'chajem t'a skal schik'il nok' chamnakxo chi' kalan yet' ha ha'.
Ukel stzikji'och t'a jun mach b'aj ek'nak jun yab'il chi', syalan winh sacerdote chi' to wach'xo jun anima chi'. Haxo nok' much pitzan chi' tz'aktajkanel nok'.

Ha jun mach tz'ilji to wach'xo, yowalil sjuk'el spichul, sb'ikanpaxel sb'a, sjoxanel xil sjolom smasanil, yik wach'xonhej tz'ajkani. Ichato chi' syalxo yoch t'a yol campamento, palta uketo k'uhal skan ichnhej ta', maxto yal-laj yoch t'a yol b'aj kajantaxoni.

Haxo t'a yukil k'uhal chi', wach' tz'aj sjoxji'el sjolom. Wach' tz'aj sjoxanel xil sti' yet' sk'u sat yet' pax masanil xil ay t'a sniwanil, sjuk'anel spichul, sb'ikanpaxel sb'a. Icha chi' tz'aj sb'oxikani.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u, syik'ankot chawanhok nok' kelemtak kalnel yet' junok nok' kob'es kalnel, jun ab'il sk'inal junjun nok', malaj jab'ok spalta'il nok'. Skotpax nanhal yukil libra ixim harina te wach' kalab'il yet' aceite, tz'ak'ji ofrenda'il yet' pax oxe'ok octavo aceite.
Haxo winh sacerdote chi' schekanoch linhan jun anima yet' yofrenda chi' t'a yichanh Jehová t'a sti'elxo skajnub' b'aj sch'ox sb'a.
Slajwi chi', tz'ik'jikot jun nok' kelem kalnel chi' yet' aceite, sb'akhchajb'at t'a yichanh Jehová silab'il yuj smul jun anima chi'.

Ha b'aj schamtaxon nok' tz'ak'ji silab'il yuj mul yet' nok' silab' stz'a smasanil, hata' smiljicham nok' kelem kalnel chi', yujto a nok' tz'ak'ji yuj mul, yik winh sacerdote tz'ajkan nok', icha nok' tz'ak'ji yuj stupkanel mul, a juntzanh tik yik Jehová yaji.

Slajwi chi' a winh sacerdote chi' tz'ik'ankot jab'ok schik'il nok' silab' yuj mul, sukanoch winh t'a sjayil schikin t'a swach' jun mach sb'oxi sk'ol chi', t'a smam sk'ab' t'a swach' yet' t'a yiximal smam yok t'a swach'.
Syik'anpaxkot jab'ok aceite winh sacerdote chi', sekanem winh t'a yol sk'ab' t'a sk'exanh,
slab'anem jun sb'ab'el yiximal sk'ab' winh t'a swach' t'a skal aceite, stzikem ukelok aceite chi' winh t'a yichanh Jehová.

Ha aceite tzato kan t'a sk'ab' winh sacerdote chi', sukoch winh t'a jun anima ix b'oxi sk'o'ol chi', hanheja' t'a sjayil schikin t'a swach', t'a smam sk'ab' t'a swach' yet' pax t'a yiximal smam yok t'a swach', haton b'aj ayxo och schik'il nok' silab' yuj smul.
Haxo jab'okxo aceite tz'ak'jikank'e t'a sjolom jun anima chi'. Icha chi' tz'aj stupkan smul t'a yichanh Jehová.

Slajwi chi' syak'anpax nok' silab' winh sacerdote chi', haton nok' silab' yuj yak'ji tup mul. Icha chi' tz'aj stupkanel smul jun anima chi'. Slajwi chi', smiljicham nok' kalnel stz'a smasanil silab'il.
Junnhej tz'aj yak'jik'e nok' t'a yib'anh altar yet' ofrenda tz'ak'ji t'a tas swaji. Icha wal chi' tz'aj stupkanel smul jun anima chi' t'a yichanh Jehová, sb'oxikani.

Tato meb'a' jun anima b'aj ix ek' jun yab'il chi', malaj stumin yik syak' nok' silab' sk'anchaj chi', anhej junok nok' kelem kalnel syik'koti yik sb'akhchajoch silab'il t'a yichanh Jehová yuj smul, chab'nhej libra ixim harina te wach' kalab'il yet' aceite syak'a' yet' oxe'ok octavo aceite.
Syik'paxkot chawanhok nok' paramuch yalnhej tas makanhil, hato ha' jantak stzak'wan smanani. Jun nok' tz'ak'ji silab'il yuj yak'ji tup smul, jun nok' snhusjitz'a'ok.
Ha t'a swajxakil k'uhal syik'ankot masanil juntzanh tik jun anima chi' t'a winh sacerdote yik sakb'ikaneli. Ha juntzanh tik tz'ak'ji'och t'a yichanh Jehová t'a sti'elxo skajnub' b'aj sch'ox sb'a.
Slajwi chi' syik'ankot jun nok' kalnel winh sacerdote yet' aceite chi', sb'akhanek' winh t'a yichanh Jehová t'a silab'il yuj yak'ji tup smul jun anima chi'.

Smilancham nok' kelem kalnel chi' winh, syik'ank'e jab'ok schik'il nok' winh, sukanoch winh t'a sjayil schikin jun anima chi' t'a swach', t'a smam sk'ab' t'a swach' yet' t'a yiximal smam yok t'a swach'.
Slajwi chi' syak'ank'e jab'ok aceite chi' winh t'a yol sk'ab' t'a sk'exanh.
Yet' sb'ab'el yiximal sk'ab' winh t'a swach', stzikanem ukelok aceite ayem t'a yol sk'ab' winh chi' t'a yichanh Jehová.
Syak'paxoch jab'ok aceite chi' winh t'a schikin jun anima chi' t'a swach', t'a smam sk'ab' t'a swach' yet' t'a yiximal smam yok t'a swach', haton b'aj toxo ix och schik'il nok' silab' chi'.
Haxo jab'okxo aceite chi' skani, syak'k'e winh sacerdote chi' t'a sjolom jun anima chi', yik stupkanel smul t'a yichanh Jehová.
Slajwi chi', smilancham nok' paramuch chi' winh sacerdote chi' schawanhil.

Ha junok nok' paramuch chi' tz'ak'ji silab'il yuj yak'ji tup mul, haxo junxo nok' snhusjitz'a'ok yet' pax ixim harina tz'ak'jipax t'a ofrenda'il. Icha chi' tz'aj stupkan smul jun anima ix b'oxi chi' t'a yichanh Jehová.
Haton sleyalil tik t'a junok mach ix ek' lepra t'ay, yik tz'alchaji to ix sakb'ixikani tato max tzak'wan yak'an juntzanh silab' icha wal sleyalil, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón:
Ayik ayexxo ek' t'a lum Canaán, haton lum ol wak' eyikok, talaj swak'b'at junok tas k'ustak yilji tz'el lheb'eb'ok t'a yol he pat ta',
a mach ay yik te' pat chi' yowalil skot t'a junok winh sacerdote syalani: Ay juntzanh k'ustumtak yilji wan yel lheb'eb'ok t'a yol in pat, xchama.

Ayik manto och winh sacerdote t'a yol pat chi', yowalil syal winh to tz'elta masanil tastak ay t'a yol te', yik wach' max kan juntzanh k'a'el chi' t'a yol pat tato syal winh sacerdote chi' to manh wach'ok yaj jun pat chi'. Slajwi chi' tz'och winh yil tas yilji jun k'ustum tz'el lheb'eb'ok chi'.
Tato ayik syilanoch winh to ha t'a sattak pat chi' ay juntzanh niwak k'ustum lheb'kiltak, ya'ax yilji, ma chak yilji, yelk'olal to sb'at t'a yol sattak pat chi',
haxo tz'elxita winh t'a yol te' pat chi', syalan winh to smakchajkan te' uke'ok k'uhal.
Ayik slajwi uke' k'uhal chi', sb'atxi winh sacerdote chi' yila'. Tato toxo ix te b'at lheb'eb'ok jun sk'ustumtakil chi' t'a sattak pat chi',
yowalil syal winh sacerdote chi' to slipji'elta masanil k'e'en k'e'en b'aj toxo ix och juntzanh lheb'kiltak chi', b'at yumchajkan t'a junok lugar manh wach'ok t'a sti'el chonhab'.
Syalanpax winh to sjoschajel masanil sattak yol te' pat chi', haxo masanil spokokal tz'el t'a yo'ol chi', sb'at yumchajkan t'a junok lugar manh wach'ok t'a sti'el chonhab'.
Ch'okxo k'e'en k'e'en tz'ochpaxkan sk'exulok k'e'en tz'ik'chajelta chi', ch'okxo lum lum tz'ochpax t'a sattak yol pat chi'.
Tato scheklajxik'e juntzanh k'ustum lheb'kiltak chi' ayik toxo ix ik'ji'el k'e'en k'e'en chi' yet' toxo ix joschajel sattak pat chi', toxo ix ochpaxkan sk'exul,
sb'at yilanxi winh sacerdote chi'. Tato toxo ix el lheb'eb'ok jun sk'ustumtakil chi', manhxo wach'ok tz'ajkan jun pat chi'.
Yuj chi', a jun pat chi' yowalil spojchajemi. Masanil te te', k'e'en k'e'en yet' lum lum ayoch t'a jun pat chi', b'at ak'jikan t'a junok lugar to manh wach'ok t'a sti'el chonhab'.
Yalnhej mach tz'och t'a yol jun pat chi' t'a uke' k'uhal ayik toxo ix yal winh sacerdote to smakchajkani, manh wach'ok tz'ajkani icha yalan ley, masanto t'a sk'ik'b'ikanemi.
Yalnhej mach swa'i, ma sway t'a jun pat chi', yowalil sjuk'el spichul.
Palta tato ayik tz'och winh sacerdote yil jun pat chi', syilan winh to a juntzanh lheb'kiltak chi' max b'eyb'ati yiktax ix b'ojikan yol te' pat chi', syal winh to wach'xo jun pat chi'.
Yik sakb'ixikan te' pat chi', tz'ik'jikot chawanhok nok' much yet' jab'ok te' k'ute' yet' lana ch'al k'ik' schakil yet' te' hisopo.
Smilancham junok nok' much chi' winh sacerdote t'a yib'anh ha ha' ayem t'a yol jun lum chen, haton ha' skot b'aj sk'e'ul sjaj junok ha ha'.

Slajwi chi' syik'anb'at te' k'ute' chi' winh yet' te' hisopo yet' lana ch'al k'ik' schakil yet' junxo nok' much pitzanto, slab'anem winh t'a skal ha ha' kalanxo yaj yet' schik'il nok' much ix miljicham chi' t'a yol lum chen chi'. Ukel stzikoch winh t'a te' pat chi'.
Icha chi' tz'aj sakb'ixikan jun te' pat chi' yuj schik'il nok' much chi' yet' ha ha' sk'e'ul sjaj, yuj nok' much pitzanto, yuj te' k'ute', yuj te' hisopo yet' lana ch'al k'ik' schakil.
Slajwi chi', tz'aktajkanb'at jun nok' much pitzan chi' t'a sti'el chonhab'. Icha chi' tz'aj sk'anab'ajaj sleyalil t'a junok pat, wach' tz'ajkani, xchi Jehová.

Haton juntzanh cheknab'il tik t'a yib'anh lepra smalk'e'i, mato t'a yaxk'a'il, mato t'a lheb'kiltak saksak yilji, mato t'a juntzanh k'ustumtak t'a pichul yet' t'a spatiktak te' pat. Icha chi' tz'aj snachajel tastak to manh wach'ok yet' tastak to wach'. Haton t'a tik slajwikan cheknab'il t'a juntzanh tik.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón

to syal masanil juntzanh cheknab'il tik heb' winh t'a heb' yetisraelal. Yuj chi' ix yalan heb' icha tik: Tato ay junok winak ay junok yab'il t'a sniwanil, yuj chi' ay tas tz'el t'a swinakil, a jun chi' manh wach'ok yaji icha yalan ley.
Wach'chom tz'elnhej juntzanh chi', ma ay b'aj tz'och wa'an jaye'ok k'uhal tz'elxi, manh wach'ok yaji, icha yalan ley.
Yalnhej tas waynub'al b'aj sway winh winak chi', ma yalnhej tas k'ojnub'al b'aj tz'em k'ojan winh, manh wach'ok tz'ajkani.
Yalnhej mach syaman swaynub' jun winak chi', yowalil sjuk'el spichul sb'ikanpaxel sb'a, palta manh wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sk'ik'b'i'emi.
Yalnhej mach tz'em k'ojan b'aj ix em k'ojan jun winak chi', yowalil sjuk'el spichul, sb'ikanpaxel sb'a, palta manh wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sk'ik'b'i'emi.
Yalnhej mach syaman junok winak ay tas tz'el t'ay, yowalil sjuk'el spichul, sb'ikanpaxel sb'a, palta manh wach'ok yaji masanto sk'ik'b'i'emi.

Tato a junok winak ay tas tz'el t'ay chi', stzub'anoch t'a junokxo anima, a jun anima b'aj ix och stzub' chi', yowalil sjuk'el spichul, sb'ikanpaxel sb'a, palta manh wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sk'ik'b'i'emi.
Tato a jun winak ay tas tz'el t'ay chi' sk'e t'a yib'anh chej, a stz'um nok' chi' manh wach'ok tz'ajkani.

Yalnhej mach syaman junok tas b'aj tz'em k'ojan jun winak to ay tas tz'el t'ay chi', manh wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sk'ik'b'i'emi. Yalnhej mach tz'ik'anb'at junok juntzanh tastak chi', yowalil sjuk' spichul, sb'ikanpaxel sb'a, palta manh wach'ok tz'ajkani, icha yalan ley masanto sk'ik'b'i'emi.

Tato a jun winak ay tas tz'el t'ay chi', max sb'iklaj sk'ab' syaman junokxo mach, a jun ix yamji yuj chi', yowalil sjuk'el spichul, sb'ikanpaxel sb'a, palta manh wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sk'ik'b'i'emi.
Tato ay junok chen syam jun winak ay tas tz'el t'ay chi', yowalil smak'jipoj jun chen chi'. Tato a junok te te' yamk'ab' yaj syam jun winak chi', tonhej sb'ikchajel te'.

Tato sb'oxi sk'ol jun winak chi, manhxa tas tz'el t'ay, yowalil stanhwej uke'ok k'uhal, ichato chi' skanxi wach'il t'a yichanh ley. Slajwi chi' sjuk'anel spichul, sb'ikanel sb'a t'a ha ha' sk'e'ul sjaj. Icha chi' tz'aj sb'oxikani, icha yalan ley.
Haxo t'a swajxakil k'uhal, yowalil syik'kot chawanhok nok' paramuch yalnhej tas makanhil, skot t'a yichanh Jehová sk'och t'a sti'elxo skajnub' b'aj sch'ox sb'a, syak'an nok' t'a junok winh sacerdote.

Jun nok' syak' winh sacerdote chi' silab'il yuj yak'ji tup smul jun anima chi', haxo junxo nok' snhusjitz'a'ok. Ha winh sacerdote chi' tz'ak'anoch masanil juntzanh chi' t'a yichanh Jehová, yik sakb'ixikan jun winak ek'nak jun yahelal chi' t'ay.
Tato a junok winak tonhej tz'el yinhatil, yowalil sb'ikel sb'a, palta manh wach'ok tz'ajkani, icha yalan ley, masanto sk'ik'b'i'emi.
Yalnhej tas k'apakil ma tz'u'um b'aj ix och yinhatil jun winak chi', yowalil sjuk'ji'eli, manh wach'ok tz'ajkani, icha yalan ley masanto sk'ik'b'i'emi.
Tato a junok winh winak yet' junok ix ix ay tas sk'ulej, yowalil sb'ikel sb'a heb', palta manh wach'ok tz'ajkan heb', icha yalan ley masanto sk'ik'b'i'emi.
Tato a junok ix ix ayoch t'a stiempo'al sb'islab' uj, manh wach'oklaj yaj ix t'a uke'ok k'uhal. Yalnhej mach syaman ix, manh wach'ok tz'ajkani, icha yalan ley masanto sk'ik'b'i'emi.
Yalnhej tas waynub'al b'aj tzek' jichan ix ayik ayoch ix t'a stiempo'al chi', ma yalnhej tas k'ojnub'al b'aj tz'em k'ojan ix, manh wach'oklaj tz'ajkani.

Yalnhej mach syaman b'aj ix ek' jichan ix chi', ma syaman junok tas b'aj tz'em k'ojan ix, manh wach'oklaj tz'ajkani. Yowalil sjuk'el spichul, sb'ikanel sb'a, palta manh wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sk'ik'b'i'emi.
Tato ay junok winh winak sway yet' ix, sb'onhchaj winh yuj tas tz'el chi' t'a ix, manh wach'oklaj tz'ajkan winh t'a uke' k'uhal, hanhejtona' manh wach'ok tz'ajkan waynub' b'aj sway winh winak chi'.

Tato ay junok ix ix tz'ilan uj t'a manh stiempo'alok, mato te niwan tiempo syak' ix yilani, a jun ix chi' manh wach'ok tz'ajkan ix ayik ayto tas tz'el chi' t'a ix, icha wal to ayto'och ix t'a yilan uj.
Yalnhej tas waynub'al b'aj sway ix, ma k'ojnub' b'aj tz'em k'ojan ix ayik ayto tas tz'el chi' t'a ix, manh wach'ok tz'ajkan juntzanh chi', ichato ayoch ix t'a sb'islab' uj chi'.
Yalnhej mach syaman juntzanh tastak chi', manh wach'oklaj tz'ajkani, yowalil sjuk'el spichul, sb'ikanpaxel sb'a, palta manh wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sk'ik'b'i'emi.
Ayik swanaj yilan uj ix chi', uke' k'uhal stanhwej ix, slajwi chi' sb'oxikan ix, icha yalan ley.
Haxo t'a swajxakil k'uhal, syik'ankot chawanhok nok' paramuch ix yalnhej tas makanhil, syik'ankot ix t'a junok winh sacerdote, t'a sti'elxo skajnub' b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová.

Jun nok' syak' winh sacerdote chi' silab'il yuj yak'ji tup smul ix, haxo junxo nok' snhusjitz'a nok'. Icha chi' tz'aj yak'anoch jun silab' chi' winh sacerdote chi' t'a yichanh Jehová yik tz'ak'ji tup smul ix, yuj tas ix el t'ay.
Icha chi' tz'aj ko sakb'itan ko b'a a onh israel onh tik t'a tas tzonh ik'ani, yik max kixtejel skajnub' Jehová ayek' t'a ko kal tik, tato ma'ay tzonh chami, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Haton juntzanh cheknab'il tik t'a heb' winak ay tas tz'el t'ay, ma tonhej tz'el yinhatil, yuj chi' manh wach'ok tz'ajkan yuj

yet' t'a heb' ix ix ayoch t'a sb'islab' uj. Ha juntzanh cheknab'il tik, yowalil sk'anab'ajaj yuj heb' ay syahelal icha chi', winak, ma ix. Tz'ochpax jun ley chi' t'a yib'anh junok winak sway yet' ix ix to manh wach'ok yaji, icha yalan ley.
Ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés ayik ix lajwi scham chawanh heb' yuninal winhaj Aarón, yujto ix skomon nitzejb'at sb'a heb' t'a slak'anil Jehová,

ix yalan t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: Al t'a winh uk'tak aj Aarón to max komon och winh t'a yol in kajnub' t'a jun lugar Wiknhej Yaji, haton jun lugar ay t'a spatikoch k'apak cortina. Max yal-laj skomon k'och winh b'aj ay smakul b'aj tz'ak'ji tup mul, haton smakul te' skaxa'il in trato, yik max cham winh, yujto a in ol in ch'ox in b'a t'a skal asun t'a yib'anh smakul skaxa'il in trato chi'.
Ayik tz'och winhaj Aarón t'a yol jun lugar chi', yowalil syik'kot junok nok' kelem wakax winh yik tz'och silab'ok yuj smul yet' junok nok' ch'ak kalnel snhusjitz'a smasanil.

Syak'och spichul winh nab'a lino, haton spichul winh jukan, yol swex winh, k'apak stzek'ul snanhal winh yet' sb'ak'ul sjolom winh. Ha juntzanh pichul chi' te niwan yelk'ochi, yuj chi' b'ab'el sb'ikel sb'a winh ichato chi' syak'anoch winh.
Haxo heb' eyetisraelal syik'kot chawanhok nok' mam chiwa heb' yik tz'ak'ji nok' silab'il yuj smul heb', syik'paxkot junok nok' ch'ak kalnel heb' yik snhusjitz'a'ok.
Syik'ankot nok' kelem wakax chi' winhaj Aarón chi' yik tz'och nok' silab'ok yuj smul. Ha jun nok' chi' yik nok' winh, yuj yak'ji tup smul winh yet' masanil heb' ayek' t'a yol spat.
Slajwi chi' syik'anpaxkot chawanh nok' mam chiwa chi' winh t'a yichanh in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.
Syak'anoch suerte winh t'a yib'anh nok' chiwa chi' schawanhil: Jun nok' tz'ak'ji silab'ok t'ayin, haxo junxo nok', tz'ak'chajkanoch mul t'a yib'anh nok', spechchajkanb'at nok' t'a tzinan lu'um.
Ha nok' tz'em suerte t'a yib'anh to wiko', syik'kot nok' winhaj Aarón chi' silab'ok yik stupkanel smul heb' israel.
Haxo junxo nok' chiwa chi', t'a spitzanil nok' tz'och t'a wichanh, tz'ak'jikanoch mul t'a yib'anh nok', tz'aktajkanb'at nok' t'a tzinan lu'um syik'ankanb'at smul heb' israel chi' nok'.
Ayik listaxo yaj juntzanh tik smasanil, smilancham nok' kelem wakax winhaj Aarón chi', syak'an nok' winh silab'il yik tz'ak'ji tup smul yet' smul masanil heb' ayek' yet' winh t'a yol spat.

Slajwi chi', syik'ankot jun chaynub' yik incienso winh, b'ut'an yet' stzak'ak'il altar ay t'a wichanh yet' cha b'echanhok incienso suk'uk'i sjab', syik'anoch winh t'a yoloch k'apak cortina ayoch t'a snanhal in kajnub'.

Syak'anem incienso chi' winh t'a yib'anh tzak'ak' t'a wichanh, haxo t'a yib'anh smakul b'aj tz'ak'ji tup mul, haton smakul skaxa'il in trato, tz'och moyan stab'il incienso chi' yik wach' max cham winh.

Syik'ankot jab'ok schik'il nok' kelem wakax chi' winh, slab'anem yiximal sk'ab' winh t'a skal chik' chi', stzikanb'at winh t'a yib'anh smakul kaxa chi' b'aj tz'ochk'och winh chi', ukel stzikoch chik' chi' winh t'a yichanh smakul chi'.

Slajwi chi', tz'elxita winh, smilancham nok' chiwa winh, haton nok' tz'och silab'il yuj smul heb' israel, syik'anoch schik'il nok' winh t'a yoloch k'apak cortina chi', stzikanpaxem schik'il nok' chi' winh t'a yib'anh smakul kaxa chi' yet' t'a yichanh, icha syutej schik'il nok' kelem wakax winh t'a sb'ab'elal.

Icha wal chi' syutej winhaj Aarón chi' sakb'itan jun lugar Wiknhej Yaji yuj yalxonhej tas chukal yet' spitalil heb' israel tik. Icha chi' ol aj sakb'ikan masanil in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, haton jun ayek' heyet'ok t'a skal chukal tze k'ulej.

Malaj junok mach ayek' t'a yol in kajnub' yakb'an ayoch winhaj Aarón chi' t'a jun lugar Wiknhej Yaji yik syak'an silab' winh yik stup smul yet' smul masanil heb' ayek' yet' winh t'a yol spat yet' smul heb' chonhab' masanil.

Slajwi yelxita winh, sakb'itan altar winh ayek' t'a wichanh, haton b'aj snhusjitz'a silab', syik'anelta jab'ok schik'il nok' wakax chi' winh yet' jab'ok yik nok' mam chiwa, syak'anoch winh t'a sch'ak altar ay t'a schikin schanhil.
Stzikanoch ukel schik'il nok' nok' chi' winh yet' yiximal sk'ab' t'a yib'anh altar chi', icha chi' tz'aj sakb'itan altar chi' winh yuj he mul a ex israel ex tik.
Slajwi sakb'ikan jun lugar Wiknhej Yaji, in kajnub' yet' pax altar yuj winh, schekan winh ik'jokkot nok' mam chiwa pitzan chi'.
