Slajwi chi', syak'anb'at sk'ab' winh schab'il t'a sjolom nok', tz'och ijan winh yalanem smul yet' spitalil heb' yetchonhab' t'a yib'anh nok'. Icha chi' tz'aj skan smul heb' t'a yib'anh nok'. Haxo jun winh sik'b'ilxo'el b'at ak'ankan nok' t'a tzinan lu'um b'aj te najat.
Stijankanb'at nok' winh ta', satkanb'at nok' t'a takinh lum chi'. Icha chi' tz'aj yik'jikanb'at smul chonhab' Israel yuj nok', haton b'aj manhxalaj anima tz'ek'i.

Slajwi chi' tz'ochixta winhaj Aarón t'a yol in kajnub' yik sk'exanel spichul winh ayochi, k'apak nab'a lino, k'apak ayoch yuj winh a tz'ochta t'a yol jun lugar to Wiknhej Yaji, syak'ankan k'apak winh ta'.

Hanheja' t'a yol in kajnub' chi' sb'ikel sb'a winh, syak'anoch spichul winh syak'taxonoch t'a yopisio. Slajwi chi', snhusantz'a silab' winh, haton yik winh yet' silab' yik heb' israel chi' smasanil. Icha chi' tz'aj stupkanel smul winh yet' yik heb' yetchonhab' chi'.
Ha jantak xepu'al nok' silab' yuj mul, snhusjipaxtz'a t'a yib'anh altar.
Haxo winh b'at ak'ankan nok' mam chiwa t'a takinh lum chi', ayik sjax winh, sjuk'el spichul winh, sb'ikanpaxel sb'a winh. Ichato chi' syal yochta winh t'a yol campamento.

Ha nok' kelem wakax yet' nok' mam chiwa smiljicham silab'il yuj stupkanel mul, haton nok' tz'ik'jikot schik'il t'a yol jun lugar to Wiknhej Yaji, tz'ik'jikanb'at sniwanil nok' t'a spatikel campamento. Hata' snhusjitz'a nok' yet' stz'umal yet' masanil sniwanil.
Ha winh snhusantz'a nok' chi', yowalil sjuk'el spichul winh, sb'ikanpaxel sb'a winh, ichato chi' syal yochta winh t'a yol campamento.

Ha jun tik ley tz'ajkan t'a he kal t'a masanil tiempo ex israel ex, ma heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal. Ha t'a slajunhil k'uhal t'a yukil uj, tzex och t'a tzek'ojk'olal, malaj mach smunlaj t'a jun k'uhal chi',
yujto a jun k'uhal chi', sk'uhal yak'ji silab' yuj he mul yik wach' stupkanel he mul t'a wichanh.
Ha jun k'uhal chi', sk'uhal ik'oj ip tz'ajkani yet' tzek'ojk'olal, ley tz'ajkan t'a he kal t'a masanil tiempo.

Ha yuj chi' a ol cham winh sat sacerdote, haxo junok heb' yuninal winh tz'ochkan sk'exulok. Tz'ak'chajk'e aceite t'a sjolom, tz'ak'jipax silab' yuj yochkan yopisio, syak'anoch spichul te niwan yelk'ochi.
Ha tz'ak'an silab' yik sakb'itan jun lugar to Wiknhej Yaji, in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a yet' altar. Syak'anpax silab' yik stup smul heb' sacerdote yet' ex israel ex tik.

Ha jun tik ley tz'ajkan t'a he kal t'a masanil tiempo. Junel tz'ak'ji silab' tik t'a yol junjun ab'il yik slajwi'el he mul a ex chonhab' israel ex tik, xchi Jehová. Icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová, icha chi' ix yutej winhaj Moisés chi' yalani.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yuninal yet' t'a masanil heb' etchonhab' to in cheknab'il juntzanhxo tik:
Yalnhej mach smilancham junok nok' wakax, junok nok' kalnel, ma junok nok' chiwa silab'ok t'a spatikel campamento, ma t'a yo'ol,
palta max yik'kotlaj nok' t'a sti'elxo in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, yowalil manhxa yalan yik t'a he kal. Ha jun chi' skotkan t'a yib'anh, yujto tonhej stob'kanem schik'il nok' ta'.

Icha chi' tz'aj walani yik mantzak he komon milej nok' nok' silab'il t'a spatikel campamento, palta to tzeyik'kot nok' t'a sti'el in kajnub', haxo junok winh sacerdote tz'ak'anoch nok' silab'il yik junk'olal t'a wichanh.
Ha winh sacerdote chi' stzikanoch schik'il nok' t'a spatiktak altar t'a wichanh, haton t'a sti'elxo in kajnub', snhustz'a xepu'al nok' winh t'a wichanh, suk'uk'i sjab' swab'i.
Manhxa b'ak'inh tzeyak' junokxo silab' t'a heb' enemigo, haton juntzanh b'aj ochnak ex ejmelal. Yujnhej juntzanh chi' ex juwi'el t'a wichanh. Ha jun tik ley tz'ajkan t'a he kal t'a masanil tiempo.
Yalnhej mach heb' eyetisraelal, ma ch'ok chonhab'il kajanek' t'a he kal, tato syak' junok silab' stz'a'i, ma yalnhej tas silab'il,
palta to max yik'kotlaj t'a sti'elxo in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a yik tz'ak'ji t'ayin, a jun anima chi', manhxa yalan yik t'a he kal.
Te ay wal yowal in k'ol t'a yalnhej mach eyetisraelal ma junok ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal schi'an schik'il nok' nok'. Ha in wal ol in och ajk'olal t'ay, ol in satanel t'a he kal.

Yujto masanil nok' nok' yet' anima, a yuj schik'il pitzan, yuj chi' ix wala' to stob'ji'och schik'il nok' t'a spatiktak altar yik slajwikanel mul. Yujto ha t'a schik'il nok' chi' ay sk'inal yuj chi' syal yak'an tup mul chi'.
Yuj chi' swal t'ayex israel ex tik to malaj junok ex, ma heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan t'a he kal syal chi'an schik'il nok' nok'.
Yalnhej mach ex ma heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan t'a he kal syamchaj junok nok' nok' yuj, ma junok nok' much, haton nok' toxonton schiji, yowalil syik'kanel schik'il nok', smukankan yet' lum lum.
Yujto a chik' chi' ik'an pitzan nok', yuj chi' swal t'ayex to max yal-laj schiji nok' chib'ej ayto'och schik'il. Yalnhej mach schi'ani, satji'el t'a he kal.

Yalnhej mach ex, ma ch'ok chonhab'il schi'an nok' chib'ej to tonhej schami, mato smiljicham yuj junok nok' chi'um nok', yowalil sjuk'el spichul, sb'ikanel sb'a, palta manh wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sk'ik'b'i'emi.
Palta tato max sjuk'el spichul, mato max sb'ikel sb'a, skannhej smul chi' t'a yib'anh, xa chi, xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al juntzanh cheknab'il tik smasanil t'a heb' etisraelal: Ha in Jehová he Diosal in.
Manh he b'eyb'alej sb'eyb'al heb' aj Egipto, haton jun chonhab' b'aj ek'nak ex kajan. Manh he b'eyb'alejpax sb'eyb'al heb' aj Canaán, haton b'aj wan ex wik'anb'ati.
k'anab'ajejek in cheknab'il, tze k'anab'ajan he b'eyb'alan in k'ayb'ub'al. Ha in ton Jehová he Diosal in swala'.
B'eyb'alejek in cheknab'il yet' in k'ayb'ub'al. Ha mach ol k'anab'ajanok, ol schanhej sk'inal yuj. Ha in ton Jehová in swala'.
Malajokab' junok winh winak smulan yet' junok ix ix to ayto yuj sb'a yet'ok. Ha inton Jehová in swala'.
Malajokab' junok mach syak' k'ixwelal smam, smulan yet' snun, yelxo wal te chuk yujto snun ton wal.
Malajokab' junok winh winak smulan yet' ix yetb'eyum smam yik max yak' k'ixwelal smam chi'.
Malajokab' junok winh winak smulan yet' yanab': Yanab' yuj smam, ma yuj snun, wach'chom t'a yol spat aljinak ix, mato ch'ok b'aj aljinak, manh smojok smulan yet' ix.
Malajokab' junok winh winak syak' k'ixwelal sb'a smulan yet' ix yixchikin, yixchikin yuj yuninal, ma yuj yisil. Max yal-laj smulan yet'ok.
Malajokab' junok winh winak smulan yet' ix yune' ix yisil smam, yisil wal smam chi', schab'il yanab' yaj ix, max yal-laj smulan yet' ix.
Malajokab' junok winh winak smulan yet' ix yanab' smam, yujto ha' och smam chi' yet' ix.
Malajokab' junok winh winak smulan yet' ix snulej ix snun, yujto ha' och ix snun winh chi' yet' ix.
Malajokab' junok winh winak syak' k'ixwelal yuk'tak smam smulan yet' ix yetb'eyum winh, yujto ichato ayto yuj sb'a yet' ix.
Malajokab' junok winh winak smulan yet' ix yalib', yujto yetb'eyum ix winh yuninal winh, max yal-laj smulan winh yet' ix.
Malajokab' junok winh winak syak' k'ixwelal yuk'tak yuj smulan yet' ix yetb'eyum winh yuk'tak chi'.

Tato ay junok winh winak tz'ik'an junok ix ix, max yal-laj smulan winh yet' ix yune' ix, to schab'il yisil yaj ix. Max yalpaxlaj smulan winh yet' ix yixchikin ix, yixchikin yuj junok winh yune' ix, ma yuj junok ix yune' ix. Yelxo wal te chuk icha chi', yujto yiknhej ix yaj heb' chi'.
Malajokab' junok winh winak syik'k'e snulej yetb'eyum, max yal-laj yik'ani yakb'an pitzanto ix yetb'eyum chi', yik wach' max och ajk'olal t'a skal heb' ix.
Malajokab' junok winh winak ay tas sk'ulej yet' junok ix ix ayik ayoch ix t'a stiempo'al yik sb'isan uj.
Malajokab' junok winh winak smulan yet' ix yetb'eyum junokxo winak, manh wach'ok skan heb' t'a yichanh ley.
Malajokab' junok winh winak snhusantz'a junok yuninal silab'ok t'a jun komon Dios skuchan Moloc. Tato sk'ulej icha chi', malaj welk'och t'a yol sat. Ha in Jehová in swal tik.
Malajokab' junok winh winak smulan yet' junok yetwinakil, icha sk'ulej yet' junok ix ix, a jun chi' te yajb'entak.
Malajokab' junok winh winak smulan yet' nok' nok', malajokab' junok mach syixtejb'at sb'a t'a icha chi'. Malajokab' pax junok ix ix smulan yet' junok nok' nok', yujto yelxo wal manhxo smojok.
Malajokab' mach syixtejb'at sb'a yet' juntzanh tik, yujto ha t'a smasanil juntzanh tik, syixtejb'at sb'a juntzanh anima ol wik'el t'a eyichanh tik.
Yuj juntzanh chi', manhxo pax wach'ok yaj slu'um heb', wan wak'an yowalil t'a heb', wan wak'an satjokpaxel heb' t'a slu'um chi'.

Masanil juntzanh chi', sb'eyb'alej juntzanh anima kajan t'a jun lu'um chi', ayik manto ex k'och kajan a ex tik. Yuj chi' yelxo wal manh wach'ok yaj jun lu'um chi' yuj heb'. Palta a ex israel ex tik yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan t'a he kal, yowalil tze b'eyb'alej, tze k'anab'ajanpax in cheknab'il tik. Manh he k'ulej masanil juntzanh tastak manh wach'ok sk'ulej heb' chi', yik wach' max ex satjipax el a ex tik t'a jun lu'um chi'.
Ha mach sb'eyb'alan juntzanh tastak yajb'entak chi', yowalil satji'el t'a he kal.

Yuj wal chi' b'eyb'alejek in cheknab'il, manh he b'eyb'alej juntzanh b'eyb'al yajb'entak chi', haton juntzanh sb'eyb'alaji ayik manto ex k'ochlaj ta', manh eyixtejb'at he b'a t'a icha chi'. Ha in Jehová he Diosal in swala', xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al masanil juntzanh lolonel tik t'a heb' etisraelal: Wach'nhej tzeyutej he b'a, yujto a in Jehová in tik wach' innhej.
k'anab'ajejek he mam he nun. Tze k'anab'ajej sleyal juntzanh sk'uhal ik'oj ip to wik yaji. Ha in ton Jehová he Diosal in swala'.
Manh eyak'och he pensar t'a juntzanh yechel komon Dios, manh he b'opaxk'e k'e'en k'e'en he diosalok. Ha in ton Jehová he Diosal in swala'.
Ayik tzeyak'an silab' yik he junk'olal wet'ok, tze k'anab'ajej wal icha sleyal, yuj chi' ol in cha t'ayex.
Ha nok' schib'ejal nok' tzeyak' silab'il chi', tze chi nok' t'a sk'uhal chi' yet' t'a junxo k'u. Tato ayto nok' skan t'a schab'ji'al, snhuschajtz'a nok'.
Tato tzato he chi nok' t'a schab'ji'al chi', chukxo t'a yol in sat, maxtzak in chalaj silab' chi' t'ayex.
Ha mach schi'an nok' t'a schab'ji'al chi', max tuplaj smul chi' t'a yib'anh, yujto komon ix yutej tastak to wik yaji. Ha jun mach chi', manhxalaj yalan yik t'a he kal.
Ayik tze molank'e sat tas tzeyawej t'a he lu'um, manh pilanok tzeyutej he molank'e t'a stitak, manh ex ek' t'anhanh he sik'ank'e ixim jolom trigo skan eyu'uj.

Ayik tze molan sat te' uwa, manh ex meltzaj he say eyil t'a scha'elal, manh he sik'k'e sat sk'ajb'anemi. Ha juntzanh chi' kanokab'i, yikxo heb' meb'a' yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il yaji. Ha in ton Jehová he Diosal in swala'.
Manh ex elk'anok, manh eyal esal lolonel, manh eyak' musansatil heb' eyetanima'il.
Manh he lok in b'i t'a es. Tato icha chi' tze k'ulej ichato malaj welk'och t'ayex. Ha in ton Jehová in swala'.
Manh komonok tzeyixtej heb' eyetanima'il, manh he tok'ek' tastak ay t'a heb'. Manh eyala' to hato k'ik'an tze tup sk'u heb' winh he munlajwum smunlaj tikne'ik.
Manh he b'aj heb' chakanh, manh eyak'em tas t'a yol sb'e heb' max uji yilani, palta ayokab' welk'och t'a yol he sat. Ha in ton Jehová in swala'.

Manh he b'o tas manh tojolok ayik tze b'o'an yaj junok lolonel. Manh eyak'och he b'a yet' heb' meb'a', manh eyak'paxoch he b'a yet' heb' niwak yelk'ochi. Te tojolnhej tzeyutej he b'o'anel tas yaj heb'.
Manh ex alwok pekal t'a skal heb' eyetchonhab'. Manh he nacha'anh esal lolonel t'a yib'anh junok eyetanima'il yik smiljichamok. Ha in ton Jehová in swala'.
Mokab' chichonoch he k'ol t'a junok eyetanima'il, palta wach' to tze kacha' tzeyak'an srazón yik wach' max kotkan t'a eyib'anh yet'ok.
Manh he pak he b'a, mokab' chichonnhejoch he k'ol t'a heb' eyetchonhab'. Tze xajanej heb' ay t'a spatik schikin he pat icha tzeyutej he ya ilan he b'a. Ha in ton Jehová in swala'.

k'anab'ajejek juntzanh in cheknab'il tik. Manh he cha tajnok nok' he molb'etzal nok' yet' junokxo nok' nok' ch'ok yinhtilal. Manh he som eyinhat tzeyawej t'a he lu'um. Manh eyak'och k'apak pichul soman sch'alil yet' junokxo makan anh ch'al.

Tato ay junok ix schekab' junok mach ayxo strato yet' junokxo winh winak, palta tato ay junokxo winh smulan yet' ix, tz'ak'ji yowalil t'a heb' schawanhil. Max miljichamlaj heb', yujto mantzak tupji yik tz'el ix t'a libre.
Ha winh smulan yet' ix chi', yowalil syik'kot junok nok' ch'ak kalnel winh silab'il yuj smul chi' t'a sti'elxo in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.
Smiljicham nok', haxo junok winh sacerdote tz'ak'anoch nok' t'a wichanh, yuj stupchaj smul winh chi'.
Ayik ol ex k'och t'a lum Canaán, ol eyawan masanil makanhil te awb'en te' syak' sat. Oxe' ab'il max eyamlaj junok sat te' chi' yik tze lo'ani, yujto ay yowalil t'a yol in sat.
Haxo t'a schanhil ab'il, masanil sat te' syak' chi', tzeyak' masanil t'ayin ofrenda'il yuj eyak'an yuj diosal, yujto wik yaj te' sat chi'.
Haxo t'a yo'il ab'il, eyikxo yaj sat te' chi' yik tze lo'o. Tato ol he k'anab'ajej sleyal tik, yelxo wal ol yak' sat te'. Ha in ton Jehová he Diosal in swala'.
Manh he chi nok' chib'ej to max el schik'il. Manh eyak'och he b'a he na'anel tas tzuji, manh eyak'paxoch he b'a t'a ajchumal.
Manh setansetanok tz'aj sjoxji'el xil he jolom, manh he joxpaxel xil he sat.
Manh eyak' echnaj he b'a yuj kusk'olal yuj junok chamnak, manh eyak'och yechel junok tas t'a he niwanil. Ha in ton Jehová in swala'.
Manh eyak' k'ixwelal ix eyisil, tzeyak'anoch ix ajmul ixal t'a stemplo juntzanh komon Dios, yik wach' max ixtaxel sb'eyb'al heb' anima, yik max ixtaxpaxel he chonhab' yuj ajmulal.
Yowalil tze k'anab'ajej sleyal juntzanh sk'uhal ik'oj ip to wik yaji. Ayokab' yelk'och in kajnub' t'a yol he sat. Ha in Jehová in swala'.
Manh ex b'at he k'anb'ej he b'a t'a heb' ajchum, ma t'a heb' sk'uman spixan heb' chamnak yalani, yik wach' max eyixtejb'at he b'a. Ha in Jehová he Diosal in swala'.
K'e'anhek linhan t'a yichanh heb' ichamtak anima, niwanokab' yelk'och heb' t'a yol he sat. Ayokab'pax welk'och t'a yol he sat. Ha in ton Jehová in swala'.
Manh eyixtej junok anima ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal.

Xajan tzeyutej heb', ichato eyetchonhab' heb'. Ya'ilejek heb', icha tz'aj eya'ilan he b'a. Tze nakoti to a ex tik najtil ek'nak ex t'a ch'ok chonhab'il t'a yol yik Egipto. Ha in ton Jehová he Diosal in swala'.
Manh eyixtej heb' anima t'a tas tze chonho', tz'akanokab' eyechlab' tzeyak'lab'ej, icha he ch'anh ayik tzeyechtan he lu'um ma juntzanhxo echlab' tze k'ana'.
Ha he libra yet' eyalmul tze k'ana', tz'akanokab'i. Ha in ton Jehová he Diosal in ix ex wik'elta t'a Egipto, a in swala'.
Yuj wal chi', yowalil tze k'anab'ajej in b'eyb'al yet' masanil in cheknab'il tik. Ha in ton Jehová in swala', xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:

Al masanil juntzanh cheknab'il tik t'a heb' etisraelal: Yalnhej mach ex, ma heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan t'a he kal tz'ak'an junok yuninal silab'il t'a komon Dios skuchan Moloc, a jun chi' yowalil sjulk'enajcham yuj heb' yetchonhab'.
Skotpax wowal t'a jun anima chi', tzin satel t'a skal heb' yetchonhab', yujto ix yixtejb'at in kajnub', ix in spatikaneli, yujto syak' yuninal silab'il t'a jun komon Dios chi'.
Tato a heb' yetchonhab' tonhej syilochi, max sjulk'enejcham jun anima chi' heb',

a in wal ol wak' yowalil t'a jun anima chi', t'a yetb'eyum, t'a yuninal yet' t'a masanil heb' kajan yet' t'a yol spat. Ol in satel heb' t'a skal heb' yetchonhab' yet' heb' syak'em sb'a t'a komon Dios Moloc chi' yet'ok.

Tato ay mach sb'at sk'anb'ej sb'a t'a heb' ajb'a'al, ma t'a heb' sk'uman spixan heb' chamnak yalani, sk'anab'ajan tas syal heb' chi', ol wak' yowalil t'a jun anima chi', ol in satel t'a skal yetchonhab'.
Junelnhej tzeyak'och he b'a t'a yol in k'ab', wach'nhej tzeyutej he b'a, yujto a in Jehová in tik, he Diosal in.
Ha wal in b'eyb'al tze b'eyb'alej, tze k'anab'ajani, yujto a in Jehová in tzex wak'och wikok.
Yalnhej mach sb'aj smam snun yowalil schami, a wal tz'ik'ankot schamel chi' t'a yib'anh.
Tato ay junok winh winak smulan yet' ix yetb'eyum junok yetanima'il, yowalil scham jun winak chi' yet' jun ix ix chi'.
Tato ay junok winh winak smulan yet' ix yetb'eyum smam, syak' k'ixwelal smam chi'. Ha jun winak chi' yowalil schami, schampax ix ix chi', a wal heb' tz'ik'ankot schamel t'a yib'anh.
Tato ay junok winh winak smulan yet' ix yalib', yowalil scham heb' schawanhil, yujto yelxo wal te chuk sk'ulej heb'. Ha wal heb' tz'ik'ankot schamel t'a yib'anh.
Tato ay junok winh winak smulan yet' yetwinakil, icha sk'ulej yet' junok ix ix, yowalil scham heb' schawanhil. Ha wal heb' tz'ik'ankot schamel t'a yib'anh, yujto yajb'entak tas sk'ulej heb' chi'.

Tato ay junok winh winak tz'ik'an junok ix ix, syik'anpaxk'e snun ix ix chi' winh, te chuk tas sk'ulej heb' chi', yuj chi' a jun winh winak chi' yet' chawanh heb' ix ix chi', snhusjitz'a heb'. Yuj chi' manhxa b'aj ol b'inaj jun b'eyb'al chi' t'a he kal.
Tato ay junok winh winak smulan yet' junok nok' nok', a winh chi' yowalil scham winh, schampax nok' nok' chi'.
Tato ay pax junok ix ix smulan yet' junok nok' nok', a jun ix chi' yowalil scham ix, schampax jun nok' nok' chi'. Ha wal tz'ik'ankot schamel t'a yib'anh.

Tato ay junok winh winak syik' yanab' yetb'eyumok, yanab' yuj smam ma yanab' yuj snun, a chawanh heb' chi', t'a wal yichanh heb' yetchonhab' heb' satji'eli, yujto a mach smulan yet' yanab', yelxo wal k'ixwelal tas sk'ulej heb' chi', yuj chi' a mach icha chi' sk'ulej, a smul chi' skotkan t'a yib'anh.

Tato ay junok winh winak ay tas sk'ulej yet' junok ix ix ayik ayoch ix sb'isan uj, malaj yelk'och t'a yol sat winh tas tz'ik'an ix chi', b'ekanpax sk'ol ix sch'oxanel syahelal chi', yuj chi' manhxa'okab' yalan yik heb' schawanhil t'a he kal.
Malajokab' junok winh winak smulan yet' yanab' smam, ma yet' snulej snun, yujto syak' sk'ixwelal winh mach ayto yuj sb'a yet'ok. Ha yuj smul heb' chi' skot t'a yib'anh schawanhil.

Tato ay junok winh winak smulan yet' ix yetb'eyum winh yuk'tak smam ma winh snulej snun, syak' wal k'ixwelal jun yicham chi', a yuj smul heb' chi' skot t'a yib'anh schawanhil, yuj chi' smiljicham heb', malaj yinhtilal heb' skani.
Tato ay junok winh winak smulan yet' ix yetb'eyum winh yuk'tak, syak' k'ixwelal winh yuk'tak winh chi', a jun chi' yajb'entak, yuj chi' smiljicham heb', malaj yinhtilal heb' skani.
B'eyb'alejek in b'eyb'al, tze k'anab'ajan masanil in cheknab'il tik yik wach' manh ol ex in satel t'a lum lum b'aj ol ex k'och kajan chi'.
Manh he b'eyb'alej sb'eyb'al heb' anima ol wik'el t'a eyichanh chi'. Ha heb' chi', sb'eyb'alej masanil juntzanh chukal tik heb', yuj chi' tzin chakel heb'.
Ha in wal ix wak' in ti' to ol wak' eyikejkan slum heb' chi' he makb'enok, lum te yax sat. Ha in Jehová he Diosal in, ex in sik'nakelta t'a skal juntzanhxo chonhab'.

Yuj chi' yowalil ay sk'exanhil nok' nok' wach' yet' nok' manh wach'ok t'a yol he sat yet' t'a skal nok' much wach' yet' nok' manh wach'ok. Yuj chi' manh he ju'el he b'a t'a wichanh yuj he chi'an nok' nok' manh wach'ok chi', nok' much, nok' snherwi, ma nok' sjachwi t'a sat lum tik, haton nok' ix wala' to manh wach'ok.
Palta yowalil wach' tzeyutej he b'a t'a wichanh, yujto wach' innhej a in tik. Ha in Jehová in tik ix ex in sik'eli, to ch'ok eyel t'a yichanh juntzanhxo chonhab', yik wach' in chonhab' tzex aji.

Tato ay junok winh winak ma junok ix ix t'a he kal sk'uman spixan heb' chamnak yalani, yowalil sjulk'enajchamok. Ha wal tz'ik'ankot schamel chi' t'a yib'anh, xchi Jehová, xa chi, xchi t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: Al t'a heb' sacerdote, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Aarón, mokab' k'och heb' t'a stz'ey junok chamnak yik manh chukok skan heb' t'a yichanh ley, wach'chom ayto yuj sb'a heb' yet' jun chamnak chi'.
Anhej tato a snun, ma smam, ma junok yuninal, ma junok yisil, ma junok yuk'tak,
ma junok yanab' heb' kob'es ayek' kajan yet'ok, a schami, syal sk'och heb' t'a stz'ey jun chamnak chi'.
Palta max yal-laj sk'och heb' t'a stz'ey junok chamnak sk'ab' yok ix yetb'eyum heb'.
Mokab' sjoxel xil sjolom heb', mokab' sjoxpaxel xil sti' heb', mokab' yak'pax echnaj sniwanil heb' yuj schamel junok anima.

Palta wach'nhejokab' syutej sb'a heb' yujto wiknhej yaj heb'. Mokab' chukok in b'inaj yuj heb', yujto a heb' snhusantz'a silab', syak'an ixim pan heb' ofrenda'il t'ayin, yuj chi' yowalil wach'nhejokab' syutej sb'a heb'.
Max yalpaxlaj yik'an junok ix ajmul ix heb', ma junok ix ix ayxo winak ix ek' t'ay, ma junok ix ix spuknak sb'a yet' yetb'eyum, yujto sik'b'ilel heb' yik tz'ochkan wikok.
Ch'okokab' yel heb' t'a yol he sat, yujto a heb' tz'ak'anoch ixim pan ofrenda'il t'a wichanh, yujto a in Jehová in wach' innhej, a in ix in sik'kanel heb' yik wach' tz'ajkan heb'.
Tato ay junok heb' ix yisil junok heb' sacerdote chi' tz'och t'a ajmul ixal, syak' k'ixwelal smam ix chi', yowalil snhusjitz'a ix.

Ha winh sat sacerdote ix ik'jik'echa'anh t'a skal heb' yuk'tak ayik ix ak'jik'e aceite t'a sjolom, ayik ix ak'chajoch spichul winh te niwan yelk'ochi, max yal-laj toxonhej sb'at tzikan xil sjolom winh, max yalpaxlaj snhik'anb'at spichul winh yuj sch'oxanel skusk'olal.
Max yalpaxlaj sk'och winh b'aj ayek' junok chamnak, wach'chom smam, ma snun yik max yixtejb'at sb'a winh.

Ha yuj schamel heb' chi' max yal-laj yel winh t'a in kajnub', max yalpaxlaj to syixtejb'at in kajnub' chi' winh, yujto ix ak'ji'och aceite t'a winh yik sik'chajkaneli, yik tz'ochkan wikok. Ha in Jehová in swala'.
Ha winh sat sacerdote, a junok ix kob'es mantalaj winak tzek' t'ay, a ix syik' winh.

Max yal-laj yik'lan sb'a winh yet' junok ix chamnakxo yetb'eyum, ma yet' junok ix spuknak sb'a yet' yetb'eyum, ma yet' junok ix ayxo winak tzek' t'ay, ma yet' junok ix ajmul ix. Palta yowalil a junok ix kob'es ix syik' winh, junok ix yetchonhab' winh,
yik manh malajok tz'aj yelk'och heb' yuninal winh t'a skal heb' yetchonhab', yujto a in Jehová in ix in sik'kanel winh, xchi Jehová, t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al t'a winhaj Aarón: Tikne'ik yet' t'a masanil tiempo, malaj junok heb' yinhtilal winh ay palta t'a sniwanil ol yal yak'an yofrenda heb' yetchonhab' t'ayin.

Yuj chi' yel wal malaj junok ay spalta'il sniwanil chi' ol yal yoch t'a jun opisio chi': Haton heb' max yal yilani, heb' tz'em sb'eyi, heb' palta snhi' ma schikin, heb' k'ichajnak xub' ma sk'ab', heb' nhojanemi sb'eyi, heb' tzapan ste'el yujto nenetak yok heb' yet' sk'ab', heb' ayoch ya'ax t'a yol sat, heb' aykan sjech'al junok yab'il t'ay, heb' ay yaxk'a t'a sniwanil yet' heb' mak'b'ilpoj snholob' sk'e'en.
Malaj junok heb' yinhtilal winhaj Aarón chi' ay palta t'a sniwanil syal yoch t'a wichanh yet' silab' to snhusjitz'a'ok. Tato ay palta t'a sniwanil chi', max yal-laj yak'an ofrenda t'ayin.
Syal swa'an juntzanh ofrenda chi' heb' yet' masanil juntzanh tastak to wik yaji,

palta max yal-laj yoch heb' t'a in kajnub', ma sk'och heb' t'a stz'ey altar, yik max yixtejb'at in kajnub' chi' heb', yujto a in Jehová in, wik yaj juntzanh tastak chi', xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Yuj chi' masanil juntzanh tik ix yal winhaj Moisés t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yuninal winh yet' t'a masanil heb' yetisraelal.
Ix lolonxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi', ix yalani:
Al t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yinhtilal to sya'ilej wal sb'a heb' yet' ofrenda syak' heb' eyetisraelal t'ayin, yik manh chukok tz'aj in b'inaj yuj heb'. Ha in wal Jehová in swala'.

Al t'a heb' to a tikne'ik yet' t'a masanil tiempo, yalnhej mach junok yinhtilal heb' tz'ik'ankot juntzanh silab' t'a wichanh, haton juntzanh syak' heb' eyetisraelal t'ayin, tato manh wach'ok yaj jun tz'ik'ankot jun silab' chi' icha yalan ley, yowalil tz'ik'ji'el t'a yopisio t'a wichanh. Ha in wal Jehová in swala'.

Malaj pax junok yinhtilal winhaj Aarón chi' syal swa'an tastak to wik yaji tato ay lepra t'ay, ma ay tas tz'el t'a swinakil, palta hato yik wach'xo yaji icha yalan ley, ichato chi' syal swa'ani. Tato syam junok tas to manh wach'ok, junok chamnak, ma junok winak tz'el yinhatil, manh wach'ok tz'ajkani.
Manh wach'ok tz'ajkani tato syam junok nok' nok' manh wach'ok t'a yichanh ley, ma syam junok anima manh wach'ok pax yaj yuj yalnhej tasi.
Tato manh wach'ok yaji, max yal-laj swa'an junok tas to wik yaji, masanto sb'ikel sb'a.
Hato yik tz'em k'u, wach'xo yaji. Ichato chi' tzaxo yal swa'an masanil tas to wik yaji yujto yiktaxon yaji.

Ha heb' yinhtilal winhaj Aarón chi' max yal-laj schi'an schib'ejal junok nok' nok' heb', haton nok' tonhej schami, ma nok' scham yuj nok' kaltakte'al nok', yik manh chukok skan heb'. Ha in Jehová in swala'.

Al t'a heb' to sk'anab'ajej in cheknab'il heb', yik max och smul heb', yik max champax heb'. Tato malaj yelk'och in cheknab'il chi' t'a yol sat heb', skot juntzanh tik t'a yib'anh heb', yujto a in Jehová in ix in sik'kanel heb'.
Malaj mach syal swa'an tastak to wik yaji tato malaj yuj sb'a yet' heb' winh sacerdote. Eb' tonhej ayek' posado t'a heb', ma heb' tonhej smunlaj t'a heb', max yal-laj swa'an heb'.
Tato ay junok schekab' junok winh sacerdote manb'il yuj, mato ay pax heb' tz'alji t'a yol scuenta winh, a heb' chi' syal swa'an heb' masanil tas to wik yaji.
Tato a ix yisil junok winh sacerdote syik' junok winak ch'ok yel t'a skal heb' sacerdote, maxtzak yal-laj swa'an juntzanh ofrenda chi' ix, haton juntzanh tz'ak'ji t'a heb' winh sacerdote chi'.

Palta tato chamnakxo winh yetb'eyum ix, mato spuknak sb'a ix yet' winh yetb'eyum chi', malaj pax junok yune' ix, meltzajnak ix yik skajnajxi ix yet' winh smam chi', ichataxon ayik kob'esto ix, syal swa'an swa'el winh smam ix chi'. Haxo pax juntzanhxo heb' manh yinhtilok heb' sacerdote, max yal-laj swa'an heb'.

Tato ay junok mach komonnhej schi'an nok' chib'ej to wik yaji, tato manh yojtakok to wik yaji, yowalil syak' sk'exul t'a jun winh sacerdote chi', syak'an jab'okxo t'a yib'anh jun ix yak' sk'exul chi'.
Palta a heb' winh sacerdote yowalil manh komonok scha' heb' winh chijok tastak syak' heb' eyetchonhab' t'ayin.

Tato ay junok mach komonnhej schi'an nok' chib'ej wik yaj chi', manh tonhejok syiloch winh sacerdote chi', palta yowalil a jun ix chi'an nok' chi', syak' nok' silab' yik spakok jun smul chi', yujto a in Jehová in ix in sik'kanel juntzanh nok' chib'ej chi' wikok, xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi':

Al t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yuninal yet' t'a masanil heb' eyetisraelal masanil juntzanh tik: Tato ay ex, ma heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan t'a he kal, tzeyak' junok nok' nok' yik snhusjitz'a silab'il t'ayin, wach'chom yuj b'aj ix eyak' he ti' eyak'ani, mato tonhej tz'el t'a he k'ol eyak'ani,
yowalil a junok nok' smam malaj jab'ok spalta'il tzeyak'a' yik wach' tzin cha jun silab' chi'. Ha junok nok' toro, ma junok nok' ch'ak kalnel, ma junok nok' mam chiwa tzeyak'a',
palta manhok junok nok' ayoch syab'il. Tato ya'ay nok', max in chalaj nok'.

Yalnhej mach ex tzeyak' junok silab' yik junk'olal t'ayin, wach'chom yuj b'aj ix eyak' he ti' eyak'ani, ma tonhej tz'el t'a he k'ol eyak'ani, yowalil a junok nok' wakax, ma junok nok' kalnel, ma junok nok' chiwa, malaj spalta'il tzeyak'a', yik wach' tzin cha t'ayex.

Manh eyak' junok nok' nok' pena'ay t'ayin, icha nok' malaj yol sat, nok' lajwinak, nok' k'i'ich, nok' elnak junok makan sniwanil, ma ay syaxk'a'il, ma junok yab'il t'ay. Ha juntzanh nok' icha chi', max yal-laj snhusjitz'a nok' t'a waltar.

Ha mach ex tz'el t'a he k'ol eyak'an junok nok' silab' t'ayin, a junok nok' wakax, ma junok nok' kalnel syal eyak'ani, wach'chom manh lajanok ste'el yok nok'. Palta tato a junok silab' ix eyak' he ti' eyak'ani, max in chalaj nok' icha chi' yaji.
Ha junok nok' lajwinak sk'e'en, ma pojnak, ma ik'b'ilel sk'e'en nok' chi', max yal-laj eyak'an nok' silab'il t'ayin. Manh he b'eyb'alej eyak'an juntzanh nok' chi' silab'il t'ayin.
Manh he cha juntzanh nok' nok' icha chi' t'a heb' ch'ok chonhab'il yik tz'och silab'il t'ayin, yujto manh tz'akanok yaj nok', max in chapaxlaj nok', xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová chi' t'a winh:

Ayik tz'alji junok nok' yune' wakax, ma junok nok' yune' kalnel, ma junok nok' yune' chiwa, uke' k'uhal yowalil skan nok' yet' snun, haxo t'a swajxakil k'uhal, tzaxo yal snhusjitz'a nok' silab'il t'a wichanh.
Max yal-laj junnhej k'uhal tz'aj smiljicham junok nok' snun yet' nok' yune'.
Tato tz'ak'ji junok silab' t'ayin yuj ak'oj yuj diosal, ujokab' icha t'a sleyal yik wach' tzin cha'a.
Hanhejtona', tze chib'at nok' t'a jun k'uhal chi', max yal-laj skan nok' t'a junokxo k'u. Ha in Jehová in swala'.
B'eyb'alejek in cheknab'il, tze k'anab'ajanpaxi. Ha in Jehová in swala'.
Mokab' chukok tz'aj in b'inaj eyu'uj, palta to tzin eyik'cha'anh, yujto a in wal ix ex in sik'kaneli,
ix ex wik'anelta t'a Egipto yik tzin och he Diosalok. Ha in Jehová in swala', xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi':
Al t'a heb' etisraelal to a in swal icha tik: Ha juntzanh k'inh tik, walnakkani to wiknhej yaji, haton yik tze molb'an he b'a yik tzin eyik'ancha'anh.

Wake' k'uhal tzex munlaji, haxo t'a yukil k'uhal manhxa junok tas tze k'ulej. Tzeyik' eyip, tze molb'an he b'a eyoch ejmelal t'ayin yalnhej b'aj ayex ek'i. Haton jun k'uhal ik'oj ip chi' wiknhej yaji.
Haton juntzanh k'inh tik niwan yelk'ochi yuj in eyik'ancha'anh ayik tze molb'an he b'a eyoch ejmelal t'a sk'uhal walnakkani.
Ha k'inh yik tze na'ankoti ayik ex wik'anelta t'a Egipto, tz'el yich t'a yemk'uhalil t'a 14 yoch b'ab'el uj. Haton jun k'inh chi' tzeyak'ochi yik tzin eyik'ancha'anh.
Haxo t'a 15 yoch jun uj chi', tzeyak'anpaxoch k'inh yik ixim pan malaj yich yuj in eyik'ancha'anh. Uke' k'uhal anhej ixim pan malaj yich tze wa'a.
Ha wal t'a sb'ab'el k'uhal chi', tze molb'anoch he b'a ejmelal t'a wichanh. Malaj junok makan munlajel tze b'o t'a jun chi'.
Ha t'a uke' k'uhal chi', tze nhusnhejtz'a silab' t'ayin. Ha t'a yukil k'uhal tze molb'anoch he b'a ejmelal t'ayin. Malaj junok makan munlajel tze b'o'o, xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalanpax Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi':

Al t'a heb' etisraelal icha tik: Ayik ayexxo ek' t'a sat lum lum ol wak' chi' t'ayex, ayik ol he cha'anel yich he jochan ixim he trigo, a jun b'ab'el manoja tze joch chi', tzeyik'kot t'a heb' winh sacerdote.
Haxo t'a junxo k'u ayik slajwikanek' sk'uhal ik'oj ip, syak'an heb' sacerdote chi' ofrenda'il tas tzeyak' chi', sb'akhanochta heb' t'a wichanh, yik wach' tzin cha t'ayex.
Ha t'a sk'uhal tzeyak' ixim he trigo chi' ofrenda'il t'ayin, hata' tze nhuspaxtz'a junok nok' kalnel silab'il t'a wichanh, nok' jun ab'il sk'inal, mokab'a jab'ok spalta'il nok'.

Tzeyik'anpaxkot lajunhe'ok libra ixim harina te wach' kalab'il yet' aceite, yik stz'a ofrenda'il to suk'uk'i sjab' swab'i. Tzeyak'anpax junok litro wino ofrenda'il, sekji'em t'a yib'anh juntzanh ofrenda chi'.

Ha ixim ak' trigo sjochchaj chi', max yal-laj he wa'an ixim t'a panil. Max yalpaxlaj he b'olan ixim he k'uxu', ma eyax k'uxani, masanto t'a jun sk'uhal a tzeyak'an ixim b'ab'el manoja ofrenda'il t'ayin he Diosal in. Ha jun tik ley tz'ajkan t'ayex t'a masanil tiempo yalnhej b'aj ayex ek'i.
Haxo t'a junxo k'u ayik toxo ix lajwikanek' sk'uhal ik'oj ip, ayik tzeyik'ankot jun manoja ixim trigo ofrenda'il, haton t'a jun k'u chi' tze b'is uke' semana.
Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ma t'a 50 k'uhal yik toxo ix tz'akwi uke' k'uhal ik'oj ip chi', hata' tzeyak'pax junokxo ofrenda t'a ixim trigo chi' t'ayin.

Tzeyik'kot chab'ok ixim pan ofrenda'il ichataxon ixim heyik tze wa'a. Wajxake' libra ixim harina te wach' tz'och t'a junjun ixim, ayokab' b'at yich t'a skal ixim. Ha ixim pan chi' sb'akhji'och ixim t'a wichanh ofrenda'il t'a ixim b'ab'el tz'eluli yalnhej b'aj kajan ex ek'i.

Yet' ixim pan chi', syak' ukwanhok nok' kelemtak kalnel heb' eyetchonhab', jun ab'il sk'inal junjun nok' yet' jun nok' kelem wakax yet' pax chawanhok nok' ch'ak kalnel. Malajokab' jab'ok spalta'il juntzanh nok' nok' chi'. Ha nok' chi' snhusjitz'a smasanil t'ayin Jehová in tik, junnhej tz'aj stz'a yet' ixim eyofrenda trigo yet' pax ofrenda t'a wino. Ha jun ofrenda stz'a chi' suk'uk'i sjab' swab'i.
Tzeyak'anpax junok nok' mam chiwa silab'il yuj stupkanel he mul. Tzeyak'anpax chawanhok nok' kalnel junjun ab'il sk'inal ofrenda'il yuj he ch'oxanel he junk'olal wet'ok.
Ha winh sacerdote sb'akhanoch chawanh nok' kalnel t'a wichanh a in Jehová in tik yet' ixim pan ix b'o t'a ixim trigo ix b'ab'laj jochchaji, a jun ofrenda chi' wik yaji, skan t'a winh sacerdote chi'.

Ha t'a sk'uhal jun k'inh chi' malaj junok makan munlajel syal he b'o'ani. Tze molb'anoch he b'a eyoch ejmelal t'ayin. Ha jun tik ley tz'ajkan t'a he kal yet' t'a skal eyinhtilal t'a masanil tiempo yalnhej b'ajtil ayex ek'i.

Ayik sk'och stiempo'al he jochan ixim he trigo, manh he sik'k'e ixim skan t'a skal yok yet' ixim ay t'a stitak, yujto a juntzanh chi' yik heb' meb'a' yaji yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal. Ha in Jehová he Diosal in swala', xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalanpax Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al t'a heb' etchonhab' icha tik: Ha t'a sb'ab'el k'uhal yik yukil uj, tzeyik' eyip, tze molb'anoch he b'a ejmelal t'ayin, spuji k'e'en trompeta yik tze na'ankot in wach'k'olal.
Yowalil tze nhustz'a junok nok' silab' t'ayin. Malaj junok ex tzex munlaj t'a jun k'u chi', xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalanpax Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:

Ha t'a slajunhil k'uhal yoch yukil uj, haton t'a sk'uhal yik tz'ak'jikan lajwok he mul, tze molb'ejoch he b'a ejmelal t'ayin. Tzex ochpax t'a tzek'ojk'olal, tze nhusantz'a ofrenda silab'il t'ayin a in Jehová in tik.
Manh ex munlaj t'a jun k'u chi', yujto a wal t'a jun k'u chi' stupkanel he mul t'a wichanh a in Jehová he Diosal in tik.
Tato ay junok mach max k'anab'ajan yoch t'a tzek'ojk'olal t'a jun k'u chi', yowalil satji'el t'a he kal.
Hanhejtona', yalnhej mach smunlaj t'a jun k'u chi', tzin sateli.
Malaj junok mach smunlaj t'a junok yalnhej tas munlajelal t'a jun k'u chi'. Ha jun tik ley tz'ajkan t'a he kal yet' t'a skal heb' eyinhtilal t'a masanil tiempo yalnhej b'ajtil ayex ek'i.
Ha jun k'u chi', haton wal yik tzeyik'an eyip, yik tzex ochpax t'a tzek'ojk'olal, tz'el yich t'a wal sb'alunhil k'uhal yoch uj t'a k'ik'b'alil, masanto t'a k'ik'b'alil t'a junxo k'u, xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalanpax Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al t'a heb' etchonhab': Ayik 15 yoch yukil uj, tze cha'an uke' k'uhal sk'inhal chinama yuj in eyik'ancha'anh.
Tze molb'anoch he b'a ejmelal t'a b'ab'el k'u. Ha t'a jun k'uhal chi', malaj junok mach smunlaji.
Ha t'a uke' k'uhal chi', junjun k'u tze nhusantz'a silab' t'ayin, haxo t'a swajxakil k'uhal, tze molb'anoch he b'a ejmelal, tze nhusantz'a silab', yujto in k'inh yaji, malaj junok mach smunlaji.

(Haton t'a juntzanh k'inh tik tzin eyik'cha'anh a in Jehová in tik. Tze molb'anoch he b'a ejmelal, tze nhusantz'a silab'. Ay silab' snhusjitz'a'ok yet' ofrenda t'a tas swaji. Tz'ak'jipax wino silab'il yet' ofrenda'il. Junjun makan juntzanh silab' tik tz'ak'ji, hato ha' sk'uhal alb'ilkani.

Ch'ok yel juntzanh silab' chi' t'a yichanh juntzanh tz'ak'ji t'a sk'uhal ik'oj ip walnak. Ch'ok yel juntzanh silab' chi' t'a yichanh silab' tz'ak'jitaxoni. Ch'ok yel pax t'a yichanh he silab' tzeyak' he ti' eyak'ani yet' t'a eyofrenda tz'el t'a he k'ol eyak'an t'ayin a in Jehová in tik.)

Haxo t'a 15-xo yoch yukil uj, ayik toxo ix molchaj sat awb'en tz'el t'a sat lum lum, tzeyak'anoch sk'inhal t'a wichanh t'a uke' k'uhal. Ha b'ab'el k'u, sk'uhal ik'oj ip, hanhejtona' pax t'a yukub'ixi'al.

Ha t'a b'ab'el k'u chi', tzeyik'kot sattak te te' te wach', xiltak apak', sk'ab' te' tak'u ay t'a titak ha' yet' sk'ab' juntzanhxo te' k'ayum xi'il yik tzeyak'anoch k'inh yik chinama. Icha wal chi' tz'aj eyak'an tzalajb'ok he k'ol t'a uke' k'uhal chi' t'a wichanh a in Jehová he Diosal in tik.
T'a yukil uj t'a junjun ab'il, tzeyak'anoch jun k'inh chi' t'a uke' k'uhal yuj in eyik'ancha'anh. Ha jun tik ley tz'ajkan t'a he kal yet' t'a skal heb' eyinhtilal t'a masanil tiempo.
Ha t'a uke' k'uhal chi', he masanil a ex israel ex tik, yowalil tzex kajnaj t'a yoltak chinama,
yik wach' syojtakejnhejel heb' eyinhtilal b'ak'inh to ha t'a yoltak chinama ix ex kajnaji ayik ix ex wik'anelta t'a Egipto. Ha in Jehová he Diosal in swala', xchi t'a winh.
Icha wal chi' ix aj yak'an winhaj Moisés yojtakanel heb' chonhab' israel juntzanh niwak k'inh tz'ochi yuj yik'jicha'anh Jehová.
Ix yalanpax Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi':
Al t'a heb' etisraelal to syik'kot aceite heb' t'ayach, haton aceite te wach' yik sat te' olivo yik wach' aynhejoch sk'ak'al candil.

Haxo winhaj Aarón sb'o'anoch sk'ak'al, yik wach' aynhejoch sk'ak'al tzek' ak'wal t'a wichanh b'aj ay in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, t'a yichanhelta k'apak cortina b'aj ay skaxa'il in trato. Ha jun tik ley tz'ajkan t'ayex t'a masanil tiempo.
Wach' tz'aj sb'oji'och juntzanh candil chi' t'a wichanh t'a yib'anh sb'akhnub'al nab'a oro.
Tzeyik'kot ixim harina te wach', sb'o lajchawe'ok ixim pan, chanhe' libra ixim harina tz'och t'a junjun ixim.
Slajwi chi' tz'ak'chajk'e ixim t'a sat jun mexa nab'a oro t'a wichanh, cha tzol tz'ajk'e latz'an ixim, waktak ixim t'a junjun latz'an.
Tzak'anpaxem incienso te wach' t'a yib'anh junjun latz'an ixim pan chi'. Ha incienso chi' snhusjitz'a t'a wichanh, yik sch'oxani to wik yaj ixim pan chi'.
T'a junjun k'uhal ik'oj ip tz'ak'ji'em ixim pan chi' t'a wichanh, yuj sk'anab'ajan heb' etchonhab' israel in trato heyet'ok t'a masanil tiempo. Yowalil a ixim k'ixin tz'ak'ji'emi.

Haxo juntzanh ixim pan tz'ik'ji'el chi', yik winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yinhtilal yaj ixim t'a masanil tiempo. Ha heb' chi' swa'an ixim pan chi' t'a junok lugar to wik yaji, yujto te niwan yelk'och ixim t'a skal juntzanhxo silab' yiktaxon heb' sacerdote tz'ik'ji'el t'a juntzanh ofrenda snhusjitz'a t'a wichanh, xchi Jehová chi'.

Ay jun winh aljinak t'a skal heb' israel chi', israel snun winh, haxo smam winh aj Egipto. Selomit sb'i ix snun winh chi', yisil winhaj Dibri, yinhtilal Dan. Ha jun winh chi' ix yak' owal winh yet' jun winh mero wal israel t'a campamento. Ha t'a jun owal chi', a winh yune' ix israel chi' ix och smul winh yujto ix yal chuk winh t'a sb'i Jehová, yuj chi' ix ik'jikot winh t'a yichanh winhaj Moisés.
Ix tanhwaj winh masanto ix yal Jehová tas yowalil tz'utaj winh.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Ik'ekelta winh chuk ix halan chi' t'a yol campamento, haxo masanil heb' ix ab'an tas ix yal winh chi', yak'okab'k'e sk'ab' heb' t'a sjolom winh, haxo masanil heb' chonhab' sjulk'enancham winh.

Al juntzanh tik t'a heb' etisraelal: Ha mach tz'alan chuk t'a in b'i a in Jehová he Diosal in tik, tz'och smul, yowalil scham yuj smul chi'. Masanil heb' yetchonhab' sjulanchamok. Wach'chom ch'ok chonhab'il, ma eyetchonhab', tato syal chuk t'a in b'i, yowalil tz'och chamel t'a yib'anh.
Ha mach smak'ancham junok yetanima'il, yowalil tz'ochpax chamel t'a yib'anh.
Ha mach smak'ancham nok' smolb'etzal nok' junokxo mach, yowalil hanheja' nok' nok' chi' tz'ak'jipax sk'exulok.
Ha mach smak'an junok yetanima'il, tato tz'echnaj yuj, icha tas syutej chi', icha chi' tz'utajpaxi.

Tato sk'ichaj yuj, yowalil smak'jipax k'ichajok. Tato tz'elta yol sat yuj, yowalil tz'elpaxkot yiko', tato tz'el ye junok mach chi' yuj, yowalil tz'elpax yiko'. Icha wal tas syutej junok anima chi', icha pax chi' tz'utajxi.
Ha mach smak'ancham nok' smolb'etzal nok' junokxo anima, yowalil syak' sk'exul nok'. Palta a mach smak'ancham junok yetanima'il, a jun chi' yowalil schami.
Hanheja' jun ley tik tz'och yopisio t'a heb' ch'ok chonhab'il yet' t'a heb' chonhab' israel. Ha in Jehová he Diosal in swala', xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.

Icha chi' ix aj yalan juntzanh chi' winhaj Moisés t'a heb' yetisraelal, yuj chi' ix ik'ji'elta winh ix halan chuk t'a sb'i Jehová chi' yuj heb' t'a spatikel campamento. Hata' ix julk'enajcham winh. Ix sk'anab'ajej heb' sk'ulan icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' t'a lum switzal Sinaí icha tik:
Al masanil juntzanh tik t'a heb' etisraelal: Ayik ayexxo ek' t'a sat lum lum ol wak' t'ayex chi', yowalil ol yik' yip lu'um, yik tzin eyik'cha'anh a in Jehová in tik.
Anhej wake' ab'il tzex munlaj t'a sat he lu'um, haxo t'a wake' ab'il chi' syal he mesan te' eyuwa, tze molan sat.
Haxo t'a yukil ab'il, yowalil skan lum yik' yip sat yuj in eyik'ancha'anh. Malaj jab'ok tas tzeyawej t'a jun ab'il chi', max yal-laj he mesan te' eyuwa.
Max yal-laj he jochank'e wa'an ixim trigo munil sk'ib'i, ayik toxo ix ek' stiempo'al jochoj trigo. Max yalpaxlaj he molan sat te' eyuwa chi' to maj he mesa', yujto syik' yip lum t'a jun ab'il chi'.

Masanil tastak sk'ib' t'a sat lum t'a jun ab'il yik syik' yip lum chi', syal he wa'ani, syalpax swa'an heb' anima heyet'ok, haton heb' winh he chekab', heb' ix he chekab' yet' heb' smunlaj heyet'ok yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal,
yet' pax nok' he molb'etzal nok' yet' nok' kaltakte'al nok' ay t'a jun lugar chi'. Yuj chi', masanil tas sk'ib' t'a sat lum t'a jun ab'il chi', ha' ol he wa yet' nok' nok' chi'.
Ukel sb'ischaj t'a uktak ab'il. Ha uke' ab'il chi' sb'ischaj t'a ukel, tz'elk'och t'a 49 ab'il.
Haxo t'a slajunhilxo k'uhal yoch yukil uj, haton jun k'u ayik tz'ak'ji tup mul, hata' spuji k'e'en trompeta t'a masanil yol he chonhab'.

Haxo ab'il 50, a yab'ilal yoch k'inh yik tz'el masanil tas t'a libre. Ha t'a jun ab'il chi' tz'alchajel yuj yel anima masanil t'a libre t'a yol he chonhab', haton heb' schonhnak sb'a chekab'wumal, yik wach' spaxta heb' smasanil t'a skal sk'ab' yok. Hanhejtona' heb' schonhnakel slu'um skanxi lum yikok heb'.

Haxo jun ab'il 50 chi' heyik yaj a ex tik, yuj eyel t'a libre. Ha t'a jun ab'il chi', malaj tas tzeyawej, max he jochk'elaj wa'an ixim trigo tonhej sk'ib'cha'anh t'a ichnhej ta'. Manh he mes te' eyuwa, manh he molpax sat te'.
Niwanokab' yelk'och jun ab'il chi' t'a yol he sat. Ha tastak munil syak' t'a lum lum chi' tze wa'a.
Ayik sk'och jun ab'il chi', junjun ex tze chaxi he lum he chonhnakel chi'.
Yuj chi', tato ayex tze chonho', ma tze man he lum t'a junok eyetanima'il, manh he na' eyak' ganar t'a spatik jun lum chi' junjun ex.

Ha mach smanan chi', yowalil stupu', hato syala' jantak tiempo'al ix ek'b'at yab'ilal yoch k'inh yik tz'el tas t'a libre chi'. Haxo mach schonhwaj chi', yowalil scha stojol lu'um, hato syala' jayeto ab'il ol molchaj sat tas awab'il yik ol jax junxo ab'il yik tz'el tas t'a libre chi'.

Hato syala', tato niwanto yab'ilal ol molchaj sat awb'en chi', icha chi' ol aj stupchaj t'ay. Tato kenxonhej yab'ilal jun, kenxonhej pax stojol lum ol ak'chaj t'ay, yujto a sat awb'en chi' schonhchaji, hato syala' jayeto ab'il smolchaji.
Manh he komon sayej chajtil tz'aj eyak'an ganar t'a spatik heb' eyetanima'il. Palta tze ch'oxeli to ay welk'och t'a yol he sat, yujto a in ton Jehová he Diosal in.
Scham wal he k'anab'ajan in cheknab'il yet' he b'eyb'alan in b'eyb'al tik. Tato ol he k'anab'ajej, junk'olal ol ex ek' t'a sat lum lum chi'.
Te wach' ol aj sat tas ol eyawej t'a lu'um. Tzalajk'olal ol ex kajnaj t'a sat lu'um, ol eyab'lej sat tas ol eyawej chi' masanto ol ex b'ut'jok.
Talaj ol eyala': ¿Tasto ol kab'lej t'a yukil ab'il chi', tato manh ol onh awalwok, tato manh ol yalpax ko molan sat tas awab'il chi'? ta xe chi.
Manh eyak' pensar, yujto ol wak'em in wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh tas tzeyawej t'a swakil ab'il chi'. Ol ste ak'ej sat, yuj chi' a jun chi' k'okb'il syab' eyab'lan t'a oxe'ok ab'il,
yuj chi' ol eyab'lej sat tas tzeyawej ol he molkan chi', yakb'an tzex awwi t'a swajxakil ab'il. Olto eyab'lej tas molb'ab'il chi' eyuj yakb'an tz'elul sat tas tzeyawej t'a sb'alunhil ab'il.
Ha lum lum chi', max yal-laj he chonhanel lum t'a junelnhej, yujto wik lu'um. Ha ex tik tonhej paxyalwum heyaj t'a sat lu'um, majan lum heyaj t'ayin.
Tato ay junok mach schonhel slu'um, syal smananxi'el slum chi' tato syal yuj.
Tato ay junok eyetchonhab' slajwi'el masanil tas ay t'ay, yuj chi' schonhb'at slum t'a junokxo, a junok te ayto yuj sb'a yet' jun schonhan slum chi' syal smananxi'el jun lum chi' b'aj schonhnak chi'.
Palta tato ay junok mach manhxalaj junok sk'ab' yok syal smananel slu'um chi', tato smolchaj stumin sch'okoj, syal smananxi'el slu'um chi'.

Anhej to snaji, jantakxo stiempo'al schonhanel lu'um, syak'anxi meltzaj jantak k'e'en tumin t'a winh manjinak lu'um chi', hato syala' jantakto tiempo ayik ol ja jun ab'il yik tz'och k'inh yel tastak t'a libre, syik'anxi slum chi'.

Palta tato max aj k'e'en tumin chi' yuj yik smananxi'el smakb'en chi', a lum slu'um chi' skannhej lum t'a yol sk'ab' jun mach ix manan el chi', masanto sk'och junxo yab'ilal yoch k'inh yik tz'el tas t'a libre. Hato ta' librexo lu'um, syik'anxikan lum winh ix chonhan chi'.
Tato ay mach schonhan junok spat t'a yol niwak chonhab' ayoch smuro'al, syal smananxi'eli ayik manto el-laj yab'ilal schonhaneli.

Palta tato maxto yal-laj smananel jun pat chi' ayik manto k'och jun ab'il chi', a jun pat chi', skanxonhej t'a winh ix manan chi' t'a junelnhej yet' t'a heb' yinhtilal. Maxtzak yal-laj yaktajel t'a yab'ilal k'inh yik tz'el tas t'a libre.
Ha pax te' pat b'aj manh ayokoch smuro'al chonhab', lajannhej ichok komon lu'um. Syal smanjixi'eli, ma yaktajel t'a yab'ilal k'inh chi'.
Haxo heb' levita, syal smananxi'el spat heb' t'a yalnhej tas tiempo'al wach'chom ay t'a yol smuro'al schonhab' heb'.

Tato ay junok levita max yal-laj smananxi'el spat t'a yol smakb'en schonhab', haxo yik sjax yab'ilal yoch k'inh chi', syal yik'anxikan spat chi', yujto a heb' levita chi' anhej spat heb' ayoch smakb'enok t'a yoltak he chonhab'.
Ha lum lum b'aj swa skalnel heb' levita t'a spatiktak chonhab' chi', max yal-laj schonhanel heb', yujto swalab' skalnel heb' yajkan yuj schonhab'.

Tato ay junok heb' eyetchonhab' kajan t'a he lak'anil manhxalaj jab'ok tas ay t'ay, yowalil tzex kolwaj t'ay yik wach' aynhejek' t'a he kal, icha tz'aj he kolwaj t'a junok ch'ok chonhab'il sb'eyek' t'a he kal.
Manh he k'an yune' he tumin, ma stupil tastak ix eyak' majanil t'a jun eyetchonhab' chi'. Anhej to tze ch'oxo' to ay welk'och t'a yol he sat, yik wach' aynhejek' jun eyetchonhab' chi' heyet'ok.
Manh he k'an yune' k'e'en tumin tzeyak' majanil t'a jun eyetchonhab' chi', manh he mak'paxk'e stojol wa'el uk'el tzeyak' sk'exa'.
Yujto a in Jehová he Diosal in swala', a in ix ex wik'elta t'a Egipto yik swak' lum Canaán t'ayex yik tzin och he Diosalok.
Tato ay junok eyetchonhab' ayek' heyet'ok, manhxa jab'ok tas ay t'ay, yuj chi' schonh sb'a t'ayex, manh eyutok icha junok he chekab' ch'ok chonhab'il,
palta icha'okab' junok munlajwum tzeyutej, ma icha junok tonhej sb'eyek'i. Syal smunlaj heyet'ok masanto sjax yab'ilal yoch k'inh yik tz'el tas t'a libre.
Slajwi chi, tzaxo yal yel yet' yuninal t'a yol he pat, spax t'a skal heb' sk'ab' yok b'aj aytaxon slu'um.
Yujto a ex tik, in chekab' eyaji. Ha in ix ex wik'elta t'a Egipto, yuj chi' manh smojok to tzex chonhchajel t'a chekab'wumal.
Manh te yajalok tzeyutej he b'a t'a heb' eyetisraelal schonh sb'a t'ayex. Anhej to ayokab' welk'och t'a yol he sat a in he Diosal in tik.
Tato he gana tze man he chekab', winak ma ix, syal he manan t'a skal juntzanhxo nación t'a he lak'anil.
Syalpax he manan heb' ch'ok nacional ayek' t'a he kal, ma yuninal heb' ix alji t'a he kal, syal he manan heb' eyikok t'a junelnhej.
Haxo yik tzex chami skan heb' yikok heb' eyuninal. Syal yoch heb' chi' schekab'ok heb', palta malaj junok eyetisraelal tik syal eyak'anoch he b'a yajalil t'a yib'anh, yujto eyetchonhab' heb'.

Tato ay junok ch'ok chonhab'il, ma junok anima ayek' t'a he kal tik tz'och b'eyumal, haxo junok eyetchonhab' junnhej kajan yet'ok tz'och mheb'a'il, schonhan sb'a t'a jun ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a slak'anil chi', ma t'a junokxo ayto yuj sb'a yet' jun ch'ok chonhab'il chi',
syal smananxi'el sb'a, mato smanji'el yuj junok sk'ab' yok,
ma yuj junok to ayto yuj sb'a yet'ok. Tato tzaxo techaj yuj jun, syal smananel sb'a sch'okojil.

Syik' scuenta heb' t'a yab'ilal ayik ix schonhanel sb'a chi', masanto sjax yab'ilal k'inh yik tz'el tas t'a libre. Ha stojol tz'ak'ji, hato syala' jantakxo yab'ilal chi'. Icha chi' tz'aj yik'anpax scuenta jantak tumin tz'och t'a spatik smunlajel, icha stojol sk'u heb' munlajwum.
Tato ayto sk'ochxi yab'ilal chi' jun, smananxi'el sb'a, syak'an meltzaj jab'okxo k'e'en tumin, hato syala' jantak ix scha'a ayik ix schonhanel sb'a chi'.
Palta tato kenxonhej tiempo sk'och yab'ilal yik k'inh chi', haxonhej jab'xo chi' stupu'.
Lajanokab' tz'utaj icha junok heb' smunlaj t'a yab'ilal t'a junok patrón, icha pax chi' tz'utaj yuj jun ch'ok chonhab'il chi'. Manh he cha ixtaj jun eyetchonhab' chi' t'a eyichanh.
Tato max yal smananel sb'a jun, haxo yik sk'och yab'ilal k'inh chi', hata' tz'aktajel yet' heb' yuninal.
Yujto in chekab' heyaj a ex israel ex tik, a in wal ix ex wik'elta t'a Egipto. Ha in ton Jehová he Diosal in swala', xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.

Ix yalanpax Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' yik syal winh t'a heb' yetchonhab' icha tik: Manh he b'o yechel juntzanh komon Dios he diosalok. Manh he molb'ejk'e k'e'en k'e'en tz'alji maksejal, ma k'e'en k'e'en tzeyb'il ayoch juntzanh icha yechel t'ay. Manh ex em nhojan ejmelal t'ay, yujto a in ton Jehová he Diosal in.
Ha sk'uhal ik'oj ip ix wal t'ayex, niwanokab' yelk'och t'a yol he sat. Niwanokab' pax yelk'och in kajnub' t'a yol he sat, a in wal Jehová in swala'.
Tato ol he b'eyb'alejnhej in k'ayb'ub'al, tze k'anab'ajan in cheknab'il,
ol wak'b'at nhab' t'a stiempo'al, haxo yak'an sat te' eyawb'en te' yet' tas awab'il t'a lum lum chi'.

Wanto he tek'an ixim he trigo, toxo pax ix k'inhb'i sat eyuwa. Wanto he molan sat te' eyuwa chi', toxo ix japax stiempo yawchaj trigo junelxo, yuj chi' ol ex wa'ok, masanto ol ex b'ut'jok. Ol eyak' wal tzalajb'ok he k'ol t'a yol he makb'en.
Te wach'xonhej ol ex ajek' ta'. Ol ex way t'a junk'olal, malaj mach ol ex xib'tanok. Ol ex in kol t'a nok' chi'um nok' yet' t'a owal.
Ol el lemnaj heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayex, yuj eyespada ol cham heb', ol kan teljab' heb' t'a eyichanh.
Ha t'a owanhok ex, ol el lemnaj 100-ok heb' ajk'ol chi'. Haxo t'a junok 100 ex, ol el lemnaj 10 milok heb'. Ha heb' ajk'ol chi' ol cham heb' t'a eyichanh yuj eyespada.
Te wach'k'olal ol aj ex wilanochi. Ol wik' wal cha'anh he b'isul, ol wak'elk'och in trato heyet'ok.
Wanto he wa'an ixim trigo molb'ilkan eyuj yiktax junab'i, ol he b'esankanel ixim yik ol he latz'anpaxoch ixim ak'to chi'.
Ol in kajnajnhej heyet'ok, manh ol ex in chakel-laj.
Ol in ajnhejek' t'a he kal. Ha in he Diosal in, a exxo tik in chonhab' eyaji.

Ha in Jehová he Diosal in, ix ex wik'elta t'a Egipto, yik wach' max ex kannhej chekab'ok ta'. Ha in ix wik'el jun munlajel manhxo jantakok sya'il ayoch t'a eyib'anh. Yuj wal chi' manhxo nhojanok ex emi tzex b'eyek'i.
Palta tato a ex tik manh ol he k'anab'ajej, manh ol he b'eyb'alej in cheknab'il,
tato ol he patikejel in b'eyb'al tik, tato malaj yelk'och juntzanh in cheknab'il tik t'ayex, tzeyixtanb'at in trato ix in b'o heyet'ok,

a in pax tik, haton juntzanh tik ol in k'ulej heyet'ok: Ol wak'b'at xiwk'olal t'a eyib'anh. Ol wak'b'at juntzanh yab'il manhxa yanhal yet' k'ak'al yab'il ol kot t'ayex syixtan yol he sat, ol pax yip he niwanil. Nab'axonhej ol eyawej tastak, yujto a heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayex ol wa'anb'at sat tas tzeyawej chi'.
Ol in och ajk'olal t'ayex, ol ex satel yuj heb' eyajk'ol chi'. Ol ex kan t'a yalanh yuj heb'. Toxonhej ol ex el lemnajok, wach'chom malaj mach tzex pechani.
Tato hanheja' max in he k'anab'ajej, wach'chom toxo ix jawi juntzanh tik t'a eyib'anh, masnhej ol k'echa'anh eyahelal wuj yuj he mul.
Ol wak' lajwokem eyak'umtakil. Manhxo ol yak'laj nhab', yuj chi' manhxa tas ol yal sk'ib' t'a sat lum he lum chi'.
Nab'axonhej ol eyixtej he b'a he munlaji, manhxalaj tas ol k'ib' t'a sat lum lum chi'. Manhxo ol yak'pax sat te' eyawb'en te'.
Tato te pit ol eyutej he b'a t'ayin, manh ol in he k'anab'ajejnhej, ol te k'echa'anh yahelal t'a eyib'anh wu'uj, hato syala' jantak he mul.
Ol wak'b'at nok' chi'um nok' t'a he kal, ol schi'anb'at eyuninal nok' yet' nok' he molb'etzal nok', haxo yemta he b'isul chi' yuj nok', yuj chi' manhxa mach ol b'eyek' t'a yoltak b'e.
Tato hanheja' max he na he b'a yuj juntzanh chi', pitnhej tzeyutej he b'a t'ayin,
a in xo, te niwan yahelal ol wak'b'at t'a eyib'anh yuj he mul chi'.

Ol wak'b'at owal t'ayex eyahelalok, yuj in pakan t'ayex yujto max he k'anab'ajej in trato. Toxonhej ol ex b'at lemnaj he kol he b'a t'a he chonhab', palta hata' ol wak'b'at k'ak'al yab'il, icha chi' ol aj he kan t'a yalanh yuj heb' winh eyajk'ol chi'.

Ayik ol wik'anemta yel he wa'el, lajunhwanh wal heb' ix ix, junnhej ol sb'o swa'el t'a junok k'ak'. Haxonhej t'a echlab'il ol aj yek' he wa'el chi' t'a he patik. Ol ex wa'ok, palta manh ol ex b'ut'joklaj.
Wach'chom ix eyil juntzanh yahelal chi', palta tato hanheja' max he na he b'a, hanheja' tze pitejnhej he b'a,
a in pax tik ol wak' yowalil t'ayex yet' wal yowal in k'o'ol. Masnhej ol k'echa'anh eyahelal wu'uj yuj he mul.
Ichato wal chi' ol he chi'anb'at heb' eyuninal yet' heb' eyisil.

Ol in pojem juntzanh lugar b'aj tzex och ejmelal t'a he diosal, ol in mak'poj eyaltar yik incienso. Ol in molb'ejk'e b'ulan he niwanil t'a yib'anh juntzanh he diosal manh pitzanok chi', yujto ol ex in chakeli.
Ol laj in jukanb'at he chonhab' yet' spatil he diosal chi'. Manhxo ol in tzalaj yuj suk'uk'i'al sjab' he silab'.
Ol wak' lajwokem he chonhab' chi', haxo heb' ajk'ol ol jakan kajan t'ay, ol sat sk'ol heb' yilan jun chi'.
Ol ex wak'an saklem t'a skal masanil nación. Tzak'an wespada t'a he patik ol ex b'atok. Ha he chonhab' chi', kuseltak ol ajkanok, xiwk'olaltak ol aj sjuwikanb'ati.

Ichato wal chi' wach' ol aj skan lum sch'okojil t'a masanil tiempo ayik ayexto'ek' t'a juntzanhxo nación ayoch ajk'olal t'ayex chi'. Icha wal chi' ol aj yik'ankan yip lu'um, icha stiempo'al to maj yik' yip lum eyuj t'a yalanhtaxo ayik ayex ek' kajan ta'.

Ha heb' eyinhtilal pitzanto b'aj ay slugar heb' eyajk'ol chi', ol wak' wal och xiwk'olal t'a yib'anh heb'. Ol el lemnaj heb' ayik ol yab'an heb' yem k'otnaj junok te' xil te'. Ol el heb' ichato ay junok mach tzak'anoch yet' espada t'a spatik heb'. Toxonhej ol komon telwok heb', wach'chom malaj mach spechan heb'.
Ol komon telwokb'at junjun heb', ichato wan yel heb' t'a owal, wach'chom malaj mach spechan heb'. Manhxalaj junok heb' ol to stek'b'ej sb'a t'a yichanh heb' ajk'o'ol.
Ol lajwokem heb' t'a skaltak juntzanh nación chi', ichato a slugar heb' ajk'ol chi' ol satanel heb'.
Ha mach t'a skal heb' eyinhtilal pitzantokanek' t'a schonhab' heb' eyajk'ol chi', hata' ol cham heb' yujnhej schukal, yuj pax smul heb' smam yicham heb'.

Ayik toxo ix in och ajk'olal t'ayex chi', ayik toxo pax ex wak'kanb'at t'a schonhab' heb' eyajk'o'ol, yujto ix he pitej he b'a t'ayin, tato hata' sna sb'a sk'ol heb' eyinhtilal b'aj ix spitej sb'a heb' chi' t'ayin, tato syak'em sb'a heb' t'a wichanh yik syalank'eta smul heb' yet' he mul a ex tik,
tato icha chi', ol in na'ankot in trato wak'nak to ol wak' lum lum t'a winhaj Jacob, t'a winhaj Isaac yet' t'a winhaj Abraham.

Palta ha t'a yalanhto chi', ol ex el t'a sat he lu'um chi'. Ol kan tzinan lu'um, ol yik'an yip lu'um ayik manh ex ayok ek' ta'. Tz'akan ol aj he tupan el he mul, yujto ix he patikejel in b'eyb'al yet' in cheknab'il.

Wach'chom icha chi' tzex wutej, ayik ayek' heb' eyinhtilal t'a schonhab' heb' yajk'ol heb' chi', manh ol in patikejel-laj heb'. Manh ol in satel-laj heb' yik manh ol lajwokek' in trato ix wak' yet' heb' yujto a in Jehová in, sDiosal in heb'.

Haxo ol ajok to yuj swach'ilok heb', ol in nakot in trato ix in b'o heyet'ok ayik ix ex wik'anelta t'a Egipto. T'a wal yichanh juntzanhxo chonhab' ix ex wik'elta, yik wach' tzin och he Diosalok. Ha in ton Jehová in swala', xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Haton juntzanh b'eyb'al tik, cheknab'il yet' k'ayb'ub'al ix yak' Jehová t'a jolom witz Sinaí t'a winhaj Moisés yik sk'anab'ajan heb' chonhab' israel.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al juntzanh tik t'a heb' etisraelal: Tato ay mach tz'ak'an sti' yak'an junok anima t'ayin Jehová in tik, palta snib'ej smananel jun anima chi', yowalil syak' stojol, stupu' icha yalan jun lista tik,
icha echlab' sk'anchaj t'a in kajnub': Ha heb' 20 ab'il sk'inal masanto t'a 60 ab'il, tato winak, yowalil tz'ak'ji 50 siclo k'e'en plata stojolok. Tato ix, 30 siclo plata syak'a'.
Haxo yuj heb' oye' ab'il sk'inal masanto t'a 20, tato winak, 20 siclo k'e'en plata syak'a'. Tato ix jun, 10 siclo k'e'en syak'a'.
Haxo yuj heb' unin jun ujal sk'inal masanto t'a oye' ab'il, tato winak, oye' siclo k'e'en plata syak'a'. Tato ix jun, oxe' siclo k'e'en syak'a'.
Haxo yuj heb' icham anima ek'xo t'a 60 ab'il, tato winak, 15 siclo k'e'en plata syak'a', tato ix jun, 10 siclo k'e'en syak'a'.
Tato ay junok anima yelxo wal meb'a' jun, max yal-laj yak'an icha sb'isul k'e'en to chekel yaj chi', tz'ik'chajkot t'a yichanh junok winh sacerdote, snaji jantak wal syal yak'ani.
Haxo pax yuj nok' nok' to tz'ak'jitaxon silab'il t'ayin, masanil nok' tz'ak'ji t'ayin chi', chekel tz'ajkan nok'.
Max yal-laj sk'exji nok' yet' junokxo nok', wach'chom wach' nok', ma chuktak wal nok'. Palta tato sk'exji nok', a nok' sk'exul chi', skanxonhej nok' yet' nok' chekeltaxon yaj chi'.
Haxo pax yuj junok nok' nok' manh wach'oktaxon yoch silab'il t'ayin jun, a nok' chi' tz'ik'jikot t'a junok winh sacerdote,

yik wach' snaji jantak stojol nok', hato syala' chajtil yilji nok'. Icha stojol nok' ix naji yuj winh sacerdote chi', ichanhej chi' tz'ajkan stojol nok' yik schonhchaj yuj yochkan stojol nok' yikok in kajnub'.
Tato hanheja' mach ay yik nok' chi' snib'ej smananpaxel nok' jun, yowalil syak' stojol nok' nab'ilxo chi', syak'an jab'okxo más t'a yib'anh stojol nok' chi'.
Tato ay mach syak' spat t'ayin, tato wach' yaji, mato chuktak wal yaji, a junok winh sacerdote sna'ani jantak wal stojol. Icha chi' tz'ajkan stojol chi' t'a junelnhej.
Palta tato a mach ay yik jun pat chi' snib'ej smananeli, yowalil syak' jab'okxo más t'a yib'anh icha stojol ix najikan chi', ichato chi' syik'anxi spat chi'.

Tato ay junok mach syak' junok makan slu'um t'ayin, a stojol lum lum chi' snaji, hato ha' jantak sat tas tz'el t'a sat lu'um. Tato b'alunhe' arroba ixim cebada tz'elta t'a lu'um, 50 siclo plata stojol lu'um.
Tato tz'ak'ji lum lum chi' t'a yol yab'ilal yoch k'inh yik tz'el tas t'a libre, skanxonhej stojol lum icha ix aj snajikan chi'.

Palta tato ayik toxo ix lajwi'ek' jun ab'il chi' tz'ak'ji lu'um, a winh sacerdote syal sna'ani jantak k'e'en plata syal yak'ji. Tz'ik'ji'emta jab'ok stojol lu'um, hato syala' jayeto ab'il yik ol jax junxo ab'il k'inh chi'.
Tato a junok mach ix yak' slum chi' t'ayin, snib'ej smananpaxeli, yowalil syak' jab'okxo más t'a yib'anh icha stojol nab'ilkani. Ichato chi' syal yik'anxikan slu'um chi'.
Tato max smanel lum mach ix ak'an chi', palta to schonhb'at lum t'a junokxo anima, tato icha chi', maxtzak yal smananxi'el lu'um.
Ayik skan lum lum chi' t'a libre t'a yab'ilal he cha'an k'inh yik tz'el tas t'a libre, a jun lum chi', wik tz'ajkan lu'um, haxo heb' sacerdote smakb'enankan lu'um.
Tato ay mach syak' sti' yak'an junok lum lum t'ayin to manb'il yuj, manh smakb'enoktaxon yaji,

a junok winh sacerdote sna'an stojol yet' jun anima chi' masanto sjax yab'ilal k'inh yik tz'el tas t'a libre. Ha t'a jun k'u chi' syak' stojol lum jun anima chi', hato ha' jantak ix aj snaji, tz'ochkan k'e'en tumin chi' wikok.
Haxo yik sjax jun ab'il chi', smeltzajxi lum t'a mach ix chonhan chi', syalelk'ochi haton jun mach aytaxon yik lu'um.
Ha stojol junok tas sna heb' sacerdote stupchaj icha k'e'en tumin sk'anchaj b'aj ay in kajnub'. 20 geras yalil junjun siclo k'e'en plata.
Ha sb'ab'el yune' nok' wakax, ma nok' kalnel, ma nok' chiwa, wiktaxon yaj a in Jehová in tik. Malaj mach syal yak'an juntzanh nok' chi' yofrenda'ok t'ayin yujto a sb'ab'el yune' nok' wiktaxon yaji.

Tato a sb'ab'el yune' junok nok' to manh wach'ok icha yalan ley, syal smanjixi'el nok' yuj mach tz'ak'an chi', hato syal jantak stojol nok' ix naji, syak' jab'okxo más t'a yib'anh icha stojol chi'. Tato manhok mach ay yik nok' chi' smananeli, hanheja' icha stojol nok' nab'ilxo chi', syal schonhji'el yuj heb' sacerdote.

Yalnhej tas tz'ak'ji t'ayin t'a junelnhej, junok anima, ma junok nok' molb'etzal nok', ma junok lum lum to smakb'entaxon yaj jun mach tz'ak'an chi', ma junokxo tasi, max yal-laj schonhchaji, max yalpax smanji'el yuj mach ix ak'ani. Wikxo yaj t'a junelnhej.
Haxo pax junok anima toxonton ayoch chamel t'a yib'anh, max yal-laj smanji'eli. Ha jun anima chi' yowalil tz'ochxonhej chamel chi' t'a yib'anh.
Ha sdiezmo'al sat masanil tas tz'awchaj t'a sat lum lum tik, wach'chom sat ixim, ma sat te te', wiktaxon yaji.
Tato ay junok mach snib'ej smananel jun diezmo chi', yowalil syak' jab'okxo más t'a yib'anh icha stojol chi'.
Jun t'a lajlajunhwanh nok' wakax, ma nok' kalnel, ma nok' chiwa, haton nok' chi' skan t'a diezmo'al t'ayin tato wach' nok', ma ay spalta'il nok'.

Max yal-laj sik'laj nok', ma sk'exchaj nok' yet' junokxo nok' ch'ok yeli. Tato ay mach snib'ej sk'exan nok', a nok' b'ab'el chi' yet' pax nok' tz'ak'ji sk'exulok nok' chi', skanxonhej nok' schawanhil. Max yalpaxlaj smanji'el nok', xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ha t'a jolom witz Sinaí ix yak' juntzanh cheknab'il tik Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi', yik chonhab' Israel yaji.
